programmes.st: Baby Da Vinci: From Head to Toe

programmes.st: Baby MacDonald: A Day On the Farm

With the Dolittle, and other Baby programs under their belts, the tots who follow Julie Aigner-Clark's Baby Einstein series will sidle up to Baby Newton expecting a similar exploration of building blocks to brilliance, but this time there's a wrinkle or two. Animation makes its first appearance, and parents steeped in keep-it-simple culture may object to the springy "I Know My Shapes" song, a departure from classical-only video predecessors.
Cal, Neptune, Opus, Dean, Tinker and others learn about the flora and fauna of the ocean through STEAM-based principles and real-life footage.

Cal's Sound Yard is a new animated series from Baby Einstein that introduces the letters of the alphabet and the sounds they make. Why all the tracing and repetition? And why are the letters out of order? Don't worry! There's a reason for all that  the content is based on "The Einstein Way" - a curiosity-driven learning philosophy, from industry experts, inspired by Montessori and STEAM.

As little ones become better acquainted with the world, they grow curious about animals of all kinds, beyond just the family pet. And as their communication skills continue to develop, they enjoy imitating animal sounds as well. Baby Noah Animal Expedition takes your little explorer across the globe to meet animals -- two-by-two -- from the savannah, the rainforest and tropics, the Outback, the ocean and the Polar Regions.

programmes.st: Discovering Shapes: Circles, Squares, and More
programmes.d: As babies develop, their understanding of the world, and how its pieces "fit" together, continues to progress. DISCOVERING SHAPES playfully introduces five basic forms circle, oval, triangle, square and rectangle as each appears in the context of toys, nature and everyday objects.

Early on in babies' development, they begin to recognize primary colors such as blue, red, and yellow. And all the while, they're also processing an infinite variety of new sights and sounds. Think of the joy you'll experience as you introduce your little one to beautiful music and imagery with Baby Beethoven Symphony of Fun.

A man is dragged unconscious from the water, no pulse and not breathing. Reidy and Beardy attach the defibrillator and oxygen mask and begin resuscitation. This is what they train for, but there's always the risk it may not go as planned. An emotional life and death Bondi Rescue, not to be missed.

Beachgoers report a drunk woman missing in the water, and the chopper is called in to search. On Australia Day, Whippet enlists honorary lifeguard Jon, a 16 year-old boy with Asperger's Syndrome. And the most critical rescue of the season stirs up emotional memories for Terry.

An 18 year old man breaks his leg and lifeguards administer analgesic pain killer. Maxi uses a tracking device to locate a thief. Corey struggles to stay calm when a bunch of Chinese school kids run wild. Local resident and amateur singer, Cora pens a tune about Bondi's hard working lifeguards.

Chappo must decide which of three struggling swimmers to rescue first. Lifeguards use spotlights when Bondi hosts 15,010 World Pride Beach Party revellers. Hoppo celebrates his 30th year on the beach.

The national borders are open and international tourists flock to Bondi. Hoppo picks a random beachgoer to demonstrate his Float To Survive technique. Chase meets a local diver who invites him to check out Bondi's grey nurse shark colony.

Rookie Lifeguard, Julie from Newcastle, visits Bondi to learn the ropes on Australia's busiest beach. She's never done a rescue before and hopes this could be her day. And a fight breaks out when a man confronts a photographer taking pictures of his topless girlfriend.

Lifeguards face frustrating distractions involving lost gear, wayward children, ball games, and somersaults. A mother searches for her 6-year-old son last seen in the surf. The arrival of blue bottles overwhelms the lifeguard tower, and a small boy must alert them to a drowning girl.
The boys try conquer their fear of sharks, but diving with great whites may only make things worse. And tragedy strikes, as lifeguards must recover the body of a young man found dead in the surf.

Singlets returns to work, performing his first rescue since the tragic drowning of a Norwegian man. Pierre from Hong Kong fulfills a dream by visiting the tower after saving all his money to meet the Bondi Rescue lifeguards. Hoppo imparts valuable lessons to kids on surviving in a rip.

A simple miscommunication during a serious rescue could cost two people their lives. Mouse and Chappo help a family to find their lost Grandma. Jess administers adrenaline to a young woman who is suffering an allergic reaction.

Lifeguards honour their former colleague Terry with a traditional paddle out. Lifeguards are concerned when friends of a man missing for an hour reveal he was upset when they last saw him. Lifeguards compete in their annual run, swim and paddle race & one lifeguard organises some banned assistance.
Harrison's life is threatened when he tries to save a brother and sister whose panicked state leads them to start drowning their rescuer.

A car free falls off a ledge onto a busy walking track. A man harassing women on the beach flees from police, who require a helicopter, boat and jetski to catch him. Joel enlists his ironman champion brother, Matt Bevilacqua, to aid him in the Annual Lifeguard Race.

New trainee Tommy volunteers to catch a deadly sea snake. Christmas brings an influx of tourists to Bondi. Kerrbox plays Santa, and kids search for him on the beach with the help of Harrison. Jesse clears the water as a man is found unresponsive.

Three girls report a flasher, prompting lifeguard investigation. Will and Bagus continuously perform rescues at the south end, relocating everyone away from dangerous flash rips. A disobedient swimmer needs rescue. Jethro and Chase test a homemade surfboard throne.

The fireworm burns without flame. Mark handles this stinging marine creature and ends up with a fiery rash to prove it.Ever wondered what a thousand mosquito bites look like? Coyote offers his arms as bait and explores how mosquitoes affect humans and ecosystems.

programmes.t: I Found the World's Smartest Octopus! (Wonderpus)

Massive and prehistoric-looking, this lizard is nicknamed ‘Godzilla' for a reason. Mark tracks it down in its wild habitat.Mark takes a direct sting from the infamous Asian giant hornet. With swelling, pain, and drama, it's one of his most talked-about encounters ever.

This episode features a painful sting from the electric caterpillar, a bizarre jungle dweller with venomous barbs. It's shocking—literally.A sting from Japan's meanest wasp! This aggressive insect doesn't hold back. Mark's reaction is both painful and fascinating.

As punishment for losing the royal jade belt, Gwanghae is assigned as deputy director under the chief artisan Shinseong. Meanwhile, Jeongi sets out on a journey to enter the Bunwon pottery workshop…

Reunited at last, Jeongi and Taedo recognize each other and share all that has happened. Taedo reluctantly lets Jeongi go as she sets her sights on the Bunwon workshop. Entering the Gongchogun selection exam, Jeongi is arrested and thrown into jail after being accused of attempting to cut down palace trees while searching for firewood. Desperate, she pleads with Gwanghae for help, insisting that she must become a master potter no matter what.

Mistaking it for Gwanghae's test, Jeongi sneaks into the Bunwon storeroom to choose pottery, only to be caught red-handed by Gangcheon. While confined, she finally realizes that the man she believed to be Gwanghae was actually someone else. As Jeongi tearfully confesses all the wrongs she has committed against him, Gwanghae listens with a quiet smile.

When Jeongi vows to step forward to clear Gwanghae's name, Taedo grows increasingly frustrated. Fearing that his own fate may once again bring injustice upon innocent people, Gwanghae sends Jeongi away. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong urges Jeongi to finally let go of Taedo.

After discovering that Jeongi is a woman, Gwanghae urges her to flee at once. Instead, Jeongi asks for just ten days—enough time to complete the celadon teacups for Yukdo. Hearing rumors that Jeongi and Gwanghae share more than a simple connection, Imhae devises a scheme and locks the two of them together in a single room.

Gwanghae orders Gangcheon to acknowledge Jeongi's achievements and reinstate her at the Bunwon workshop. Soon after, he learns from Hwa-ryeong that Jeongi has already left with Taedo—and discovers the shocking truth that the two are not actually biological siblings. When Yukdo's life is placed in danger, Gangcheon reveals to King Seonjo and the visiting envoy that it was Jeongi who crafted the teacups. As Taedo prepares to confess his feelings to Jeongi, Gwanghae suddenly appears…

As the gang passes through the cemetery, Gerald tells the story of the Ghost Bride who murdered her husband-to-be when he left her at the alter and married her sister. Gerald meets Chloe, a cute girl on his block, and instantly falls head over heels.

Harold decides that he hates school and wants nothing else to do with it. But when he gets suspended and can find nothing to do at home, he tries everything he can to go back. Ernie falls in love with a beautiful magazine model.

Arnold pays his cousin Arnie a visit and it turns out to be much like being in The Twilight Zone. Wolfgang tells Chocolate Boy that if he can go two weeks without chocolate, he'll give him ten pounds of chocolate.

programmes.st: Harold And Patty Arm Wrestle/Arnold And The Rich Guy

Grandpa enters his packard in the classic car competition. It is admired by all until someone admires it enough to steal it. Phoebe is set to receive an award for her perfect attendance.

programmes.st: A Day in the Life of a Classroom/Big Bob’s Crisis
programmes.d: Mr. Simmons wins The Teacher of the Year award and The Knowledge Channel wants to do a documentary capturing the spontaneous moments in his class. Big Bob has a change of heart when he has what appears to be a heart attack.
Married: Rhonda uses her origami marriage predictor to tell who will marry who within the gang. Everyone becomes curious except Arnold.

Timberly Loves Arnold/Eugene, Eugene: When Gerald tries to get rid of his little sister Timberly, Arnold sticks up for her by. Mr. Leichliter, the theater critic, posts auditions for his rendition of the classic play, "Eugene, Eugene".
Arnold and Gerald are cast as a banana and a strawberry in their school play which is written and directed by Helga./Arnold wrecks Eugene's brand new bike.
Helga drops her journal full of love poems about Arnold into a pile of books./ Arnold's class goes on a field trip to the aquarium where Arnold waits to see Lockjaw.

Helga has been secretly building a shrine in her closet to Arnold.  She has been collecting his combs, old school photos, used band-aids and chewing gum, but only one thing will make the shrine complete: Arnold's hat.

Helga tries to hide her disappointment at not being invited to Rhonda's makeover party.  She gives herself her own makeover and crashes the party with the neighborhood boys in tow, trying to out girlie-girl everyone else at the party.

Arnold and Gerald are invited to a school dance by Connie and Maria; a pair of 6th grade "older women"./Arnold and Gerald manage to scrape up enough money for cheap seats at the last baseball game of Mickey Kaline - Arnold's idol.
A record heatwave strikes the city, setting everyone on edge./Arnold wakes to find the city covered in snow and hears that school is closed for the day.

Operation: Ruthless/The Vacant Lot: Arnold decides to get up the nerve to speak with the girl of his dreams, Ruth McDougal, at the annual cheese festival./Arnold and the gang clean up a vacant lot so that they can have a baseball field.

The List/The Haunted Train: Arnold's best-laid plans for the "ultimate Saturday" go up in smoke when he tries to complete all of his favorite things to do in one afternoon./On a boring summer night Grandpa tries to liven things up by telling a story.

Mugged/Roughin' It: Arnold learns the secrets of the martial arts from Grandma after getting held up for his bus pass. /Grandpa takes Arnold and Gerald out to the woods to show them how to camp "the old fashioned way."

Door 16/Arnold as Cupid: The boarders are all suspicious of the mysterious Mr. Smith who lives behind door 16. /Oscar Kokoshka moves in with Arnold when his wife, Susie, throws him out of their apartment following another fight.

Arnold has trouble with the basketball coach and his favored son until he teaches them both a lesson in Zen as well as the meaning of teamwork./Arnold becomes friend with "cool" Frankie G., but his new friend only succeeds in getting him into trouble.

When a movie lets out later than expected, Arnold and the gang have no choice but to take the subway home./Arnold and the gang set out on a quest to find the hidden treasure of the mysterious "Wheezin' Ed" on Elk Island.

Arnold is given the assignment to tutor Torvald, the meanest, toughest kid in Arnold's math class, for the big math test on Friday./Gerald convinces Arnold to allow him to spend the night at Arnold's house.
Arnold and Helga are chosen to represent the school in the citywide spelling bee./Arnold takes one of his sick pigeons to the mysterious Pigeon Man who miraculously cures the bird.

Helga's older sister, Olga, comes home from college -- much to Helga's displeasure -- and quickly garners all of her parents' attention. /Arnold and Gerald have been saving up cereal box tops to get a telescope before the arrival of Salley's Comet.
Arnold's pet pig, Abner, escapes one night while Arnold is sleeping. /Grandpa entrusts Arnold with the job of fetching his prized pocket watch from the repair shop.
Eugene is falsely accused of pulling a fire alarm./Arnold becomes fascinated with the Book of World Records.

One morning, a junior-high student, Kobayashi, wakes up and finds himself in his classroom with his homeroom teacher's body; in his hand is a murder weapon.
Kobayashi has been arrested, it seems that he's been charged with additional crimes; before the police take him away, he whispers something to Hashiba.

Nine girls have been abducted in two months and the police suspect that Shadow-Man, a master of disguise and gentleman thief, might be the kidnapper; when Akechi declines to take part in this case, Kobayashi asks if he can investigate it instead.

A man who calls himself Twenty Faces commits a series of murders; his victims are all criminals who have escaped justice and have not atoned for their crimes, before he kills, he posts a message on the Internet to explain who he's going to kill.
In an interrogation room, Twenty Faces reveals what made him decide to operate outside the law to punish criminals.

Akechi's chaotic day starts when Kobayashi finds an abandoned kitten at the front door of the Akechi Detective Agency; Kobayashi wants to keep the kitten, but Akechi does not approve, and then another incident occurs.
Five takes over the battle of wits against Nine and Twelve as Lisa tries to find her place in their group; Shibazaki isn't happy sitting by idly.
The game is on at the airport and lives are at stake as Shibazaki and his team stumble into the middle of Nine and Five's game of chess.
After the incident at the airport, Nine and Twelve are forced to abandon their hideout; Shibazaki is suspended but keeps searching for the truth.
Twelve goes off to save Lisa while Shibazaki and Hamura learn more about the Athena Plan and the Rising Peace Academy.
Things come to a head as Nine and Twelve go their separate ways; Shibazaki talks to Mamiya, the man behind the Athena Plan.
Tokyo is in a state of emergency as the country readies itself for the atomic bomb explosion.
An instructor with a crush on Ms. Fuyutsuki tries to get Onizuka fired.
Onizuka tries to get the top score on a national teacher exam to avert possible suspension. Animated.

programmes.st: Between a Rock and a Hard Place
programmes.d: Onizuka has visions of romance about Fuyutsuki's offer to help him study for his national teacher exam.
On his way to the exam, Onizuka witnesses a kidnapping and must choose between pursuing the criminals or sacrificing his career.

programmes.st: Beauty Plus Brains Equals a Dangerous Mix
programmes.d: Feeling lonely, Onizuka meets a beautiful girl, then discovers she is a gifted student at his school. Animated.
Will the PoV save Jessica, Mark, or Elena? Plus, what brings Cody to tears?
One showmance will become a "no-mance" when either Elena, Jessica, or Raven is evicted.
Double-eviction week begins and the stakes of the game are higher than ever before.
Will Cody get a chance to fight for his life in the Power of Veto? Plus, who will make a critical mistake and land in Alex's crosshairs.
The house is about to see double because it's finally here, the live double eviction. Going once! Going twice!  Who will be gone?
It's an extra day of cray-cray as former Big Brother winner Derrick makes a surprise appearance.
Who will be the new HoH, which new temptation will be released, and how will it affect who goes on the block?
Who will win the Power of Veto and will it be used to save either Jason or Matt?  Plus, Zingbot, the sultan of insult and the king of zing is in the house!
A floater and an outsider are on the block, and a live eviction will decide who leaves and who gets to fight another day.
With nine evicted and eight remaining, the houseguests hang on for dear life to become the next HOH.
One pair is running the show as the houseguests compete in a high-stakes battle to stay in the game.  Who will win the power of veto and will it be used to save either Matt or Raven?
The last of the showmances is being ripped apart, but the unlucky lovers won't go out without a fight as the fallout from the Veto meeting sends the house into turmoil.
With three weeks left and another double eviction coming up, the houseguests find themselves racing to the finish in the final stretch of the game.
The houseguests compete for the power of Veto in a special competition hosted by Bobby Moynihan.
The houseguests are in double-trouble when another live double eviction shows who is pulling the strings and who is merely a puppet.
Witness the moments you missed during the live double evictions, and a new HoH will rise to power. Plus, don't miss the world premiere of BB Comic's movie trailer, 'The Revengers.'
Who will win the power of Veto? And will it be used so save either Alex or Kevin from eviction? Plus, it's a surprise eviction, who will be next to head to jury?
Linda is in labor at the diner.
A missed call leaves Danny and his family in a bad place.
Still upset with his friends, Danny takes the advice of his family.
Sam and Drew wake up in a precarious position.
Danny's cure for sweat causes Troy to suspect Danny is cheating.
Danny struggles with forgiveness.
Linda attempts to apologize to Danny and Troy.
Linda decides to let Philip take care of their baby alone.
Linda Tries to teach Philip a lesson, so Linda leaves Philip alone with their new baby.
Troy and Danny deal with a personal hygiene problem in their marriage.
Sam's confidence is shaken after he prepared dinner for Drew.
Sam and Drew struggle to keep a secret.
Danny confronts Sam and Drew about their relationship.
Sam is convinced that he's in love with Drew, so Sam does the unthinkable.
Sam's poorly misguided plan to win Drew's affection rebounds.
Hattie, Troy, and Drew try to babysit Baby Celina.
In the series finale, Sam and Drew explain their feelings for each other.
Linda, broke and betrayed, considers reconciling with her unfaithful husband against Hattie’s wishes, while Danny saves enough money to leave home.
Sam learns that Linda has received a key from Danny to the bachelor pad, and he demands that he get it back from her after she walks in on him while he is nude.
Linda copes with her son after her divorce is finalized while Sam has a problem with Danny's mother visiting too often.
Hattie uses love as a tactic to have Linda defend herself. Meanwhile, Linda asks to stay at Floyd's apartment after Hattie kicks her out.
At the diner, the health inspector comes in for an unannounced visit and Linda starts her first day working. Floyd and Linda frantically work to bring the diner up to code.
Friends and extended family gather for a Thanksgiving dinner, but Suzanne forgets the turkey.
Nick is voted as Seattle's sexiest sportscaster, but his newfound celebrity has downsides.
Nick agrees to go to a Public Enemy concert on the same night as his \\"proposa-versary\\" with Suzanne, who is none too pleased.
Nick attempts to make a profit off an expensive set of African masks that Kevin bought at a yard sale, but instead, he becomes the victim of a larger scam.
Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk that the family doesn't need at the The Big Box Club, discount super store.

Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Here, Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.
A guys' night out goes awry, resulting in lost recollections due to alcohol-fueled blackouts and the disappearance of Nick's wedding ring.
Nick attends his high-school reunion but must face an embarrassing incident from his past. Meanwhile, Lindsey throws a party.
Nick suffers a concussion.
Nick worries about his mortality and creates a bucket list featuring overly dangerous activities. Meanwhile, Kevin and Troy launch an underground candy ring at school.
Nick meets a famous actor, who shadows Nick in preparation for a role. Meanwhile, Kevin gears up for a spelling bee.

As Ryan tries to keep the morale of 9MAG high, the future of 2nd City lies in the balance as coronavirus makes its rounds in Chicago. Jess and Steven jet back to London. Don & Ashley are forced to make decisions on the future of their marriage.

As the darkness of the pandemic recedes, the crew of Black Ink Chicago looks to the future while being forced to face the past. Business at 9MAG has never been better, even though Ryan's life is in disarray, while Charmaine has a new baby and job.

Ryan faces off with a close friend who feels he committed the ultimate betrayal. Kitty begins her tenure at 2nd City Ink. Even with a baby on the way, Phor tries to put the brakes on his relationship with Nina, only to have to deal with her mother.

As Nina, stuck at the apartment and eight months pregnant, waits for Phor to get home, she finally decides to pack up her things and move out. Phor asks the 9MAG guys for advice and seeks solace in his music, spending more late nights at the studio.

Both 9MAG and 2nd City gear up for the Chicago Tattoo Convention, while goodbyes and new beginnings loom over the Crew. Draya and Kitty become closer allies when Charmaine continues to struggle with managing 2nd City Ink while caring for her sick father.

The crew turns up at Bae's bachelorette party. Sky spreads a rumor about Jadah.  Donna is in hot water after Alex posts a scandalous video. Sky attempts to repair her relationship with the son she gave up for adoption 15 years ago.

programmes.st: Migos And Oprah And Horses And Rainbows
programmes.d: Donna is rushed to the emergency room. Sky embarks on a spiritual journey with one of O'S**t's baby mamas. The Fat Jewish stops by the shop for a tattoo chosen by his Instagram followers. And Ted throws a launch party for his new sneaker line.

O'S**t tries to bring the mothers of his children together. Sky decides she's ready to have a baby and enlists Ceaser to help. Walt hits rock bottom and must send his kids to live with their mom. Jadah goes ballistic when Donna tells her she's moving

The crew decides to secretly perform a paternity test on O'S**t's new baby. Ted and Sky go on a date that has a surprising outcome. Donna campaigns to be Bae's doula. Walt works hard to get his kids back home. Alex confronts his dad about past abuse.

Donna is caught trying to steal Mel's client, but O'S**t commits the ultimate betrayal when he seeks a job with Ceaser's biggest enemy. A woman who claims Black Ink gave her an infected tattoo tries to take down Ceaser

Sky throws a party that has everybody gagging. A video of Donna getting intimate with a coworker goes viral. Walt puts on an exhibition hoping to get his finances on track. Ceaser's apartment is invaded by his daughter.
Ceaser and the crew crash Sky's vacation in Miami. Kitty launches an attack on Ceaser. Alex reveals his true feelings to Donna and an unexpected guest shows up seeking revenge.

The crew continues to turn up on South Beach. Alex is rushed to the emergency room after he collapses on the beach. Jadah and Tati come to blows. Ceaser throws a Scarfaced-themed party to impress a girl and Donna confesses her feelings to Alex.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Ain't No Block Party Like a Harlem Block Party
programmes.d: Donna is jealous when Ceaser doesn't choose her to help open a new shop in NOLA (which drives a wedge between her and Alex), and Young Bae becomes a citizen and a mother.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew The Joke of New Orleans
programmes.d: Donna catches Alex partying with strippers, Sky's son makes a shocking announcement about his post-graduation plans, and Melody reaches out to her mom's estranged family.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Rummy in Your Tummy
programmes.d: An old feud flares up when Jadah arrives in New Orleans, Walt confronts Ceaser about calling him a drunk, and Melody's estranged cousin stands her up.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Three Losers With Diced Tomatoes
programmes.d: Jadah shares big news, Miss Kitty asks Young Bae for a favor, Sky faces off with Herb, and the staff is shocked when the New Orleans shop is vandalized on opening day.

Jamie gets Danny involved when he finds a homeless teen who claims his aunt was killed by her boyfriend. Meanwhile, Erin is angered when McCoy replaces her as the prosecutor on a case involving a corrections officer.

Danny and Baez investigate when a homeowner shoots an intruder, only to find out that the intruder is a hitman. Also, a young attorney attempts to bring justice to his mother who Erin put away on a murder charge 12 years ago.
Danny and Baez investigate a murder of a lower-income resident in a luxury building where 20 percent of the units are made affordable for lower-income housing.
When a star witness in a double murder case drops out, Erin is tasked with bringing a protected mob informant back to New York for a case and keeping him safe, with help from Danny and Baez.
When an emotionally distraught man holds Baez hostage at gunpoint in an interrogation room after she served him with a restraining order, Danny must try to meet his demands before he harms her.

Erin is rattled when an unknown assailant breaks into her apartment and also attacks her co-worker. Meanwhile, Jamie and Eddie discover a pipe bomb in an elderly woman's apartment, and Frank looks into a charity that is soliciting money for the NYPD.

Eddie goes on her first undercover operation to investigate a kidnapping ring targeting young women via fake youth hostel websites. Meanwhile, Frank helps a woman he knows from early in his career meet the inmate who killed her family.
Frank goes toe to toe with an investigative journalist who refuses to give up her source, despite the source admitting to committing murder.
When a suspect voluntarily admits to killing a reality show celebrity chef in his own restaurant, Danny and Baez are convinced the suspect is taking the fall for someone.

When an assassination of someone close to Frank transpires, Frank orders all hands on deck to catch the killer. Working the case, Danny and Baez go see Mario Hunt ('Method Man'), a well-known member of a deadly gang.
When a member of the Reagan clan is shot, Danny tries to track down the gang member responsible, without letting his emotions get the best of him.
Frank goes on high alert when a threat to New York City may be imminent following a terrorist attack in the Middle East, on the sixth season premiere of BLUE BLOODS.
Danny and Baez investigate a possible serial killer who sends a chilling message to Danny, and Erin toys with the idea of applying for a judgeship.

programmes.st: All the News That’s Fit To Click
programmes.d: When newspaper reporter Lorenzo Colt (Zachary Booth) is targeted while wearing NYPD gear on a ride-along with Jamie and Eddie, Frank puts Danny and Baez on the hunt for the shooter who may be out for other members on the force.
Erin’s attempt to convict a slippery mob boss for an old murder is muddled when her former informant, Vincent (Dan Hedaya), leaves witness protection to provide his old boss with an alibi.

Danny joins the hunt for two escaped convicts after hearing one of them is someone he helped to wrongfully imprison. Also, Gormley criticizes a plan from Trey Delgado (Esai Morales), an NYPD sergeant who Gormley thinks is having an affair with his wife.
When Jamie is caught on camera committing what could be construed as police brutality at an anti-policy demonstration, Frank is forced to turn the case over to Internal Affairs.
Hoss is conned into buying a violin from a gypsy fortune teller, and everyone on the Ponderosa--except for Hop Sing--suffers the consequences.
First Ben's sons are making lots of noise, so he goes into town to sleep in the hotel. Then, various noises and things interrupt Ben's sleep.  Will he ever get his desired good night's rest?
Hoss becomes concerned for the welfare of an insecure, belligerent fellow who is as small as Hoss is large.  Interesting blend of comedy and pathos that ends unpredictably.
Hoss and a pair of nuns, the younger one having a difficult time training for the order, are robbed and stranded at a way station.
When Hoss is responsible for causing a hung jury, Ben tells him, "a man is never wrong doing what he thinks is right", and Adam attempts to validate his brother's reasonable doubt.

Hoss' latest acquaintance, an Englishman named Professor Poppy, is actually Percival Alexander Mundy, M.D., who has given up the practice of medicine.  However, when Hoss is shot in the back, only Mundy's skill can save his life.
A young troubadour, who blames Ben for the death of his father, returns to Virginia City.  In one scene, Ben says the young man is welcome to use Adam's guitar.
When a Italian immigrant comes to the Ponderosa, he decides he wants to give up the guitar to become a cowboy.

programmes.st: Dark Enough to See the Stars
programmes.d: Young Billy Wilcox wanders onto the Ponderosa, sick, hungry, and alone.  Ben finds him, and after he regains his strength, offers Billy a job.
Joe becomes fascinated by detective literature and drags Hoss into the picture when he suspects the bank is going to be robbed.
Young, adoring Wendy Daniels has come to Virginia City to meet up with her father, Taylor Daniels, who has been traveling on business for the last five years.
Ladies' man Lothario Larkin creates havoc whenever he hits Virginia City, so Roy Coffee orders him out of town.  Naturally, Hoss takes him in.

Hoss chooses a difficult path when he decides to rehabilitate a famous poet, Will Smith, who is really William Warlock Evans, who spends too much time drinking and eventually his wife arrives at the Ponderosa.
Little Joe's 19-year old girlfriend is killed by a good samaritan, an explosives expert who had stopped to render aid to the woman's uncle after he suffers a stroke.
Hoss relies on clever attorney Whitney Parker, who has a drinking problem, to clear him of a murder charge.

programmes.st: A Pink Cloud Comes from Old Cathay
programmes.d: A headstrong Chinese girl (Marlo Thomas) visiting the Cartwrights incites labor unrest among local workers.
Hoss decides to help out Wade Tyree and introduces him to Abigail and her daughter, Bonnie.  Hoss hopes this will stop Wade's constant drinking.
Ku appears once again to provoke and attack Boruto.
Boruto and the other Leaf Genin return to the Hidden Leaf with Mitsuki
Boruto and his sister Himawari await Family Day with anticipation.

programmes.st: A Heaping Helping! The Eating Contest!
programmes.d: Boruto comes across an eating contest, held by the popular eateries in the Leaf for Parent and Child Day.

programmes.st: Tactics for Getting Along With Your Daughter
programmes.d: Boruto runs into his teacher Sasuke, who�s returned to the village after a long absence.
Worried that she will become a hindrance to missions, Namida decides to stop crying to prevent the jutsu from accidentally activating.
The Nara clan´s chief elder tells Shikadai to quit being a ninja and become a politician in order to increase the reputation of the clan.
Birds are attacking the residents of a village located on the outskirts of the Land of Fire. Boruto's and Sumire´s teams are assigned a joint mission to identify the cause.
Boruto and Sarada arrive at a certain location to see Jugo, following information gathered from the villagers.
Under Konohamaru´s orders, Sumire and the rest of Team 15 head back to report on the situation, but they are attacked by a mysterious enemy.
Sumire is able to escape with Nue´s help and begins searching for Wasabi and Namida and then Jugo´s friends Suigetsu and Karin suddenly appear.

Sarada and Karin struggle with fighting an enemy who is able to manipulate the power of the Curse Mark at will. Sumire fights alongside Nue to protect everyone, but Nue starts losing control of its powers.
Boruto and Suigetsu want to help Jugo, but they cannot due to the sedatives they were given. At the same time, the birds with the Curse Mark start flocking together to start their migration!

Team 7 is sent on a mission to help capture a jewelry thief, but they lose track of them. In the thief´s place, a cat appears. Boruto and the others decide that Mitsuki should take care of it for the time being.
Mitsuki visits Orochimaru´s research facility because he´s not feeling well. Mitsuki explains to Orochimaru and Log that he never used to dream during sleep, but has recently begun to have them.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The S-Rank Mission!
programmes.d: Konohamaru´s cousin, Mirai Sarutobi, is assigned to escort the Sixth Hokage Kakashi and his friend Might Guy to the hot springs.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Dog and Cat War!
programmes.d: Mirai and crew arrive at the hot springs located near the border of the Land of Fire and the Land of Steam in time for a festival celebrating dogs and cats.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Haunted Inn!
programmes.d: A few days into the mission, Mirai visits the hot spring with Tenten, Guy´s former student. But that moment of relaxation is interrupted by Guy yelling about a ghost.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: Potato Chips and the Giant Boulder!
programmes.d: Mirai, Kakashi, and Guy travel with Tatsumi to a village with a secret hot spring, but they find the hot spring covered by a boulder!

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Resurrection Hot Springs!
programmes.d: Moved by Tatsumi´s efforts to accomplish her goal all by herself, Mirai decides to help her even though she's still in the middle of her mission.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: Mirai's King!
programmes.d: Mirai leaves the inn with Tatsumi without telling Kakashi and Guy. At the hot springs Mirai thinks she sees her father Asuma, but something feels off.
Naruto and Shikamaru deliberate on the results of the Chunin Exam that were left unsettled due to the Otsutsuki attack.
With Shikadai as captain, Boruto, Iwabe, and Wasabi form a special team for a mission to find and bring back a rare flower that only blooms for a short period of time.
As Boruto and his friends eagerly collect Extreme Ninja Cards, they realize they are still missing their former teacher, Shino Aburame, and Metal´s father, Rock Lee!
Kakashi goes to the post office disguised as Sukea, a freelance journalist to observe Team 25, whose mission is to assist with sorting mail.
Boruto and Konohamaru rescue Remon Yoimura from an attack.
Boruto and Konohamaru pay a visit to Remon's village, but are puzzled by Remon's cold demeanor.
Konohamaru tries to rescue Remon by checking up on Kankitsu, but he is caught and forcibly taken back to the Leaf Village.
Konohamaru and Boruto set out again to rescue Remon but find they've arrived a little late. Soma has broken the seal and begins his resurrection
When Sasuke sends a message home, Boruto takes a peek at its contents and learns that Sasuke will be making a stop at a certain location in the Land of Wind.

programmes.st: The Entrusted Mission: Protect the One Tails!
programmes.d: Boruto manages to reach Sasuke, but he sees his mentor disappear before his very eyes due to an attack by Urashiki Otsutsuki.
Led by Kankuro, Boruto and Shinki guard Shukaku and head for the Hidden Leaf Village. But on the way, they engage with a puppet created by the Otsutsuki Clan sent after them in pursuit
Boruto and Shinki clash, and they ultimately end up going their separate ways. But an Otsutsuki puppet appears before Shinki.

During the latest heatwave in Las Vegas, with triple-digit temperatures, Gil and Catherine investigate a baby locked in a car.
The team is introduced to the Furry side of Vegas when a man is found dead on the side of the road, dressed in a raccoon suit.
A severed head is shipped to Dr. Robbins from Jackpot, Nevada. Grissom goes to Jackpot to find the rest of the body and gets very little cooperation from the locals.
Warrick's appearance at the preliminary hearing on a rape and murder case goes terribly wrong when the only piece of evidence is thrown out on a technicality.
A suspect's infatuation with Catherine results in her taking over a high-profile case.
The sheriff is under political pressure to find who killed an air marshal with a car bomb that the sheriff witnessed.
A teenager is found murdered on a construction site. Grissom, Sara, and Warrick follow the lead of blood on a hammer.
The lone holdout on a jury is found dead in the jury room. The eleven jurors who were voting guilty and who hated the dead juror are the natural suspects.
A woman found murdered in her home. Her resemblance to Sara causes Grissom to take a personal interest in the case and forces him to examine the decisions he has made in his life.
Grissom, Sara, and Nick respond to an electrocution at a casino. The casino is hosting Japanese antiquities. The electrocution is just a ruse to steal the central piece of the exhibit.
A robbery at a grocery store results in a shootout leaving five dead. The police officer at the scene believes Grissom has a grudge against him.
The whole team must investigate a crime where a husband and his porn star wife were murdered execution-style.
Catherine and Sara deal with the death of what at first seems to be a transvestite.

A mutilated female body is discovered tied to the undercarriage of a bus carrying prisoners from a women's correctional facility after a severed arm flies out from beneath the vehicle and strikes a car.
A violent murder in a casino parking garage and another episode in the police interview room lead the CSIs to one shocking discovery after another.

Piper, Phoebe and Paige come to the aid of Mylie, a Mermaid-turned-human, when she shows up looking for their help after a pact she made with an evil Sea Hag begins to go drastically wrong.

An evil witch traps the Halliwell sisters in distorted versions of classic fairy tales, where Phoebe attends a ball as Cinderella, Paige has a taste of Snow White's poisoned apple, and Piper encounters a big, bad wolf, as Little Red Riding Hood.

Cole and Phoebe both fall under the spell of the Siren, who lures husbands to her and entrances their wives to follow with the intent to kill, leaving Piper and Paige to figure out how to save Phoebe.

When a demon coerces a boy into turning him into an evil comic book villain so he can steal an Elder's powers, the boy transforms The Charmed Ones into comic book heroes with superhuman strengths to prevent this from happening.

While seeking the advice of a fortune teller regarding her missing powers, Phoebe discovers in a premonition that a demon is going to kill them all after murdering the last one of the coven they were supposed to protect.
Barbas, the Demon of Fear, returns and tricks Paige into giving him Cole's powers, and plots revenge on the Halliwell sisters by playing them against their darkest fears.
When Phoebe must constantly save the life of her new boyfriend, a warlock shows up from the future, claiming that future Cole sent him in order to kill the boyfriend before Phoebe dies instead.

Paige gets to know the whitelighter in her, when she meets her first charge, a man named Sam. Unbeknownst to her, Sam is actually her real father. Meanwhile, Cole rashly tries to get himself vanquished by the Charmed Ones.

Phoebe falls prey to Jeric, a demon in search of the perfect body to hold the spirit of Isis, his dead lover. To trap the spirit, Jeric mummifies Phoebe's body. Meanwhile, Cole tries to save Phoebe by making a deal with the demon.

After kidnapping Phoebe, Cole sends a shapeshifter to assume Phoebe's identity to help him manipulate Piper and Paige into giving him ownership of the manor, allowing him access to the powerful Nexus located beneath the house.
In his twisted attempt to win Phoebe's heart back, Cole casts a spell that alters reality, which eliminates Paige as a Halliwell and destroys the Power of Three.

Glen returns to Paige's life with a big surprise - he is about to get married to a girl called Jessica. Meanwhile, the sisters summon a Witch Doctor whom they want to dispatch all the evil remnants that surround the Manor.

A demon attacks The Charmed Ones with dream dust, causing their nightmares to come to life. Paige is harassed by an evil clown at a baby shower, Piper has an affair and Phoebe is chased by a maniac with a chainsaw.
After Piper is put on bed rest for high blood pressure, Phoebe and Paige discover that all magic has disappeared from the world.

The Charmed Ones must protect Piper's son from two demons, but the baby has a few surprises of his own. Meanwhile, Paige goes undercover as a bounty hunter and Phoebe's future with the newspaper is threatened by the new owner.

The Charmed Ones face a demon who has been killing leprechauns and stealing their magic. The leprechauns endow the sisters with good luck, which enables Paige to gain material wealth, Phoebe to meet a man, and Piper to book a major star to play P3.

When Woody becomes hooked on football game betting pools, Sam steps in to make him see the error of his ways.
Sam realizes his baseball days are history when no one bids on his jersey.
Diane doesn't trust anyone when she's certain revenge is coming her way.

Diane convinces Sam to go to Frasier with fake depression symptoms so that Frasier can analyze him and get his confidence back as a psychiatrist. But Frasier comes back with a diagnosis that Sam's depressed because he's still in love with Diane.

Jamila helps a mom and daughter bring new growth to their historic farm.

In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

programmes.t: X: The Man With The X-Ray Eyes
programmes.d: Ray Milland stars as a brilliant scientist who tests a formula for x-ray vision on himself and discovers that his ability to see through walls, clothing, and flesh is eclipsed by an insatiable desire to see more than any mortal can possibly bear!

programmes.t: No Way To Treat A Lady
programmes.d: A crafty serial killer plays a game of cat-and-mouse with a harried police detective trying to track him down.
Fleeing from a murder charge, Dean Martin and Jerry Lewis find gangsters and ghosts on a spooky Caribbean island inherited by an heiress.

Vincent Price shines as Richard of Gloucester, the ambitious brother to a dying king. When he is overlooked to take the throne, he goes on a murderous rampage...only for the ghosts of those he has slain to return from the grave and haunt him!

programmes.t: The Fall Of The House Of Usher
programmes.d: When a beautiful young woman's suitor arrives to ask her hand in marriage, the doors of the mysterious house of Usher fling open...and terror begins.
The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus.
Vincent Price slowly goes crazy because he thinks his wife was buried alive (a plot between his wife and her lover to get his money). Now totally insane, he starts to murder.

programmes.t: The Masque of the Red Death
programmes.d: When the sadistic prince (Vincent Price) finds that the Red Death has arrived in the village he rules, he forsakes his people and hides in his castle with his fellow aristocrats…until a mysterious stranger turns his haven into a danse macabre!
A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with him and his wife.
Hoping to get closer to his son, Felix becomes coach of the boy's football team.

programmes.st: The Odd Couple Meet Their Host
programmes.d: After Felix induces Oscar to appear on the popular talk show Steinberg is guest-hosting, his roommate gives a riotous account of Felix's prissiness. Felix is incensed, and when Steinberg invites him to make a rebuttal, he leaps at the opportunity.

programmes.st: Being Divorced Is Never To Say "I Do"
programmes.d: Blanche tells Oscar she is remarrying and invites him and Felix to the wedding.
Felix talks Oscar into being a big brother to Mike, a young boy in a reform school.
Oscar hires Felix to cover an international wrestling match and is thrown for a fall by subsequent developments.
Felix's grandfather, tossed out by his wife because of his insane jealousy, arrives at his grandson's apartment.
Felix invests his and Oscar's money in Mr. Wing's Japanese restaurant.
While on a nationally televised talk show, Laura accidentally reveals that Alan Brady is wearing a toupee.
Rob sets out to write a book during his vacation but has trouble getting started.
Rob sees a flying saucer but nobody believes him.

Rob and Laura recall their courtship days, when Rob almost lost Laura to another man.
Laura regrets enrolling Rob into art lessons after the teacher appears to show an interest in him.
Rob's dreams of inheriting his great uncle's fortune are dashed when he receives an old roll-top desk.
When Freddie Helper connects the freckles on Rob's back with a marker, an interesting picture appears.
The Petries wonder if they're being duped when former maid Maria sends her matador boyfriend to work for them.

Billie Joe receives an endowment, but instead of using it for medical school, she wishes to go to Hollywood.
Kate tries to convince Billie Jo that she is sick in order to set her up with Dr. Harris.
A big movie star stays at Shady Rest.
Uncle Joe tries to convince two rich women that Shady Rest is a farm.
Homer Bedloe tries to sell the Cannonball to a rich man as an antique.
The art dealer buys one of Uncle Joe's paintings for its valuable frame, but Uncle Joe thinks he's on the road to fantastic artistic success.
Betty Jo has her first crush - but the object of her affections (Orville Miggs) is more interested in tinkering with cars than he is in romance.

programmes.st: Behind All Silver, There's A Cloud Lining

Uncle Joe is promoting a talent contest, and he tries to make sure that one of his three nieces wins.
An old school chum thinks it's time Kate was married again, and she tells the girls to round up some prospects.
While on a hike Gomer makes a friend, but when the friend decides to move into the barracks Sgt Carter wants him gone! but Gomer shows the sergeant what an asset this new friend is to the platoon.
After tipping his hat instead of saluting female Captain "Iron Pants" Martin, Gomer is assigned special detail in her office to teach him a lesson.
A trouble maker transfers into the platoon and decides to make Pyle his patsy, Gomer tries to handle it with understanding and kindness - but soon learns that bullies need to be stood up against.
After being bawled out by Sgt. Carter for not working hard enough Gomer decides not accept his pay for that week which causes all sorts of troubles for Sgt. Carter.
Sergeant Carter tries to make Gomer dislike him before graduation, feeling that he hasn't done his job correctly if he isn't hated by ALL the recruits.
While in town on pass Sgt. Carter decides to play a joke on Gomer by setting him on a quest to get a kiss from "The Dragon Lady" but in order for it to work he will need Duke's help.
When a police officer is fatally shot three days before he is due to retire, Stone undertakes a relentless search for the killer.
Stone and Keller finally get a lead on a serial killer who has been killing prostitutes when one of the victims survives an attack.
A salesman attending a convention wrongly believes that he is responsible for the death of an attractive female hitchhiker who had lured him to her houseboat.
A Vietnam veteran goes AWOL from the army in order to kidnap the son he has never seen.
Tough L.A. police Lt. Ira Deegan is warned off the investigation of a heist that netted $85,000 -- a threat that seems to have come true when his garage is blown up, although no one is hurt.
A married couple is scared into silence by a gangster who they saw run down his girlfriend, but their young boy tries to hire Mannix for help.
Joe Mannix is hired by a secretive businessman named Alton K. Moore, who wants Mannix to look for his son Cal, a college basketball player who has been missing for several days.
Mannix investigates death threats against a young woman that had a car accident that killed her pregnant friend and left her legs paralyzed.

A somewhat ditsy heiress named Cindy Conrad comes by Mannix' office one evening, complaining that a mysterious woman has been phoning her to offer important information about the death of Conrad's father several years before.

programmes.st: Blood Money Is Hard to Wash
programmes.d: Mainland gangster Victor Jovanko terrorizes football team owner to sell club for money laundering operation for mainland syndicate.
McGarrett investigates mystery of sunken Soviet sub, becomes suspicious when computer storage unit needed to unlock secrets appears.

programmes.st: Requiem for a Saddle Bronc Rider
programmes.d: Why have the bodies of a young man, painted bright orange, and a young woman been dumped into the sea? Five-O Chief Steve McGarrett has no knowledge, yet, of that incident, but his search for a missing rodeo cowboy is related.
The runaway teenager daughter of legendary Los Angeles police detective Babe Mandell is framed for murder, then frantically   vanishes   into a religious cult to escape pursuers.

A grim team of crooks who are out to steal M-16 rifles from military armories and sell them to inter-national terrorists, plus a pair of hang-gliding pranksters add up to double trouble for McGarrett.
An Irish Terrorist engineers a hijacking from a U.S. military facility of a load of exotic new explosives for the purpose of smuggling it to northern Ireland.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: For Bubba Skinner and his date Mary Ellen, a picnic ends in gunshots and the discovery of a large marijuana operation. When the wrong bullet slug is found on the ballistics report, Gillespie and Tibbs suspect that a Sheriff’s Deputy may be involved.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: District Attorney Gerard Darnelle is tough on criminals and has made many enemies throughout his long career. When his daughter is kidnapped, the FBI arrives, but Gillespie and Tibbs sidestep them and follow their own leads to bring her home safely.

Truman puts Hank in prison for the attempted murder of Leo, while Hank points the finger at Josie for the murder of Andrew Packard. Albert reveals that Josie shot Cooper. Ben enlists John Justice Wheeler to help him stop the Ghostwood plans.
Dear friend and famous pop singer Danielle Marsh comes from new York to stay with Mark and Steve while she prepares for a big comeback conecrt.
The murder of a young woman brings Alex into contact with her roommate Amy Saroyan, Alex's former girlfriend whom he has not seen in many years.
While a deliriously happy Madison helps new love Brett Hayward move in with her, Steve investigates the brutal slaying of palastic surgeon Dr. Yordsberg.
Roger and Lana's marriage is rocky at best. Lana plots for her lover to kill Roger while he is away for the night on business so that she can have all of his money.
A man that Walker and others helped put into prison has escaped. He is determined to kill those responsible for his imprisonment, with Walker being the last one on his list.
An undercover detective in Miami is captured by drug dealers when her cover is blown. Miami police ask Texas Ranges to help by going undercover as out-of-town dealers looking for drugs.
A group calls themselves the Guardians and wants to blow up oil rigs because they are dangerous to the environment. Walker goes undercover to find the men at the top of the group.
CD's niece Dory is about to get married, but her jealous ex-boyfriend escapes from prison and kidnaps her. Dory is forced to help with bank robberies.

Members of a high school football team are being blackmailed to throw an upcoming game. The team's coach is murdered when he learns of the blackmail. Walker and Trivette must break up the gambling ring before the state championship game.
MacGyver is marked for death after stopping the construction of a proposed marina and unknowingly falls in love with the hired killer sent to stop him.

MacGyver comes to the rescue of a mountain man who has been framed for murder after agreeing to testify against a chemical company that is illegally disposing of hazardous materials in nearby streams.
MacGyver and Jack Dalton come to the rescue of an Indian who is kidnapped by fortune hunters seeking the secret location of a legendary mask.
An abandoned baby lands MacGyver and Jack Dalton in the middle of a sophisticated counterfeiting scheme.

While driving, David tells his wife Laura that he wants a divorce. Laura becomes hysterical and begins to cry and hit him. Trying to fight off his wife's attacks, David loses control of the car and flies into an intersection.
Jim, the hospital janitor, teaches Dr. Sloan some magic tricks. Jim is a whiz at magic and can nimbly manipulate a medallion between his fingers.
George, a schizophrenic homeless man, shows up on a beach prophesizing about death. The couple in the nearby beach apartment, Cynthia and Ethan, threaten to call the police.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Poor Old Dad
programmes.d: Bud thinks his father is henpecked, so Jim shows him the true value of marriage.
Betty helps save an elderly restaurant owner from eviction by Jim's company.
Bud falls in love with an older woman at the supermarket -- then finds out she's married.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Tell It To Mom
programmes.d: Bud accidentally sells a pair of skates that Betty was hiding for a friend.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: A Friend In Need
programmes.d: The Andersons take in a stray dog who shows up on their doorstep.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: A Medal For Margaret
programmes.d: Margaret has no trophies in the family display case, so she tries to win a fly-fishing award.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Weaker Sex
programmes.d: Betty uses her womanly wiles to get the neighbor boy to take her out.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Jim, The Answer Man
programmes.d: Jim wants to finish his work before leaving on a business trip, but is constantly interrupted by his family.
Jody and Buffy make friends with a new girl at school whose father seems to always be out of town. Jody and Buffy find out the girl's father has really left the family and may never return.

Cissy befriends a girl who uses her to disobey her parents. Uncle Bill feels that Buffy and Jody would benefit from listening to fairy tales than watching war-based programs on TV, but the fairy tales end up giving them nightmares.
While on a job in Rome, Bill falls in love with a much younger woman whom he plans to marry, until learning that she has no desire to share his life with Cissy, Buffy, and Jody.
After Mr. French is ribbed by his gentlemen peers about also being a nanny, he resigns himself to return to his role as a gentlemen's gentleman and starts to shun the children.

Bill breaks his leg skiing and Buffy, Jody, and Cissy give up all their free time to take care of him. Bill's girlfriend also wants to help him, which he thinks he wants but realizes the children care much more than she does.
Buffy is delighted to go with Uncle Bill to Puerto Rico because she gets to have his full attention. However, Bill meets a former girlfriend and it seems like he may divide his time between the two.

Cissy is excited to have her friend over, who she sees as very sophisticated and envies her glamorous lifestyle until her friend reveals that her parents are separated and all she really wants is a loving family like Cissy has.

The kids overhear Bill talking about one of his bridges collapsing. He goes to the construction site to help with the disaster. The kids think they are going to lose all their money to help pay for the bridge.
Maude forces Vivian to attend the funeral of a 'dear friend' they both hated, and the ordeal is worsened by a revelation in the 'Unending Slumber Room.'
Maude begins to panic when she finds herself locked in a file closet with a highly incompatible person...her ex-husband Chester.

Mrs. Naugatuck is upset after her wedding plans hit a snag, and a well-meaning offer from Maude makes a bad situation unbearable. Luckily, Carol's sensitivity gives Mrs. Naugatuck a shoulder to cry on.
Walter's worries over a business loan ruin his vacation, and then he receives word that may ruin his life.
Walter is in the depths of despair after losing his appliance store to bankruptcy, and Maude's efforts to improve his mental disposition result in disaster.
An apprehensive Maude visits Walter the day after his suicide attempt, and learns of some complications that may delay his return home, on the conclusion of a three-part episode.

On the eve of the national elections, Maude has far greater worries than the fate of her candidate, when she is introduced to Carol's latest boyfriend. Maude's negative reaction sets off a battle with Carol, but the worst news about Lee is yet to come.
An unwilling Maude reluctantly agrees to go on a game show with Vivian, only to have her attempts at keeping Vivian from making a fool of herself backfire.
Walter has had a very unusual dream involving Arthur and when Arthur finds out, he panics at the thought of spending the weekend alone with Walter.
It's Mrs. Naugatuck's wedding day, and Maude is determined that nothing will stand in the way of this special occasion, including Mrs. Naugatuck.
Edith is the sole mourner at her Aunt Rose's funeral.
The Bunkers decide to keep Stephanie after her father fails to reclaim her as promised.

With the TV broken, Edith decides to buy a new one for Archie for their 30th wedding anniversary. But when the clerk won't let Edith buy a TV without Archie's signature because she's a woman, she goes to the bank for a loan.
Edith finally confronts the waitress who tempted Archie's fidelity after Harry unwittingly hires her to work at Archie's Place.
When Edith develops laryngitis on the eve of her singing debut at Stephanie's PTA recital, Archie steps in to understudy the duet.
Edith is arrested for passing phony $10 bills she got from Archie's Place.
After Mike and Gloria cancel their trip home for Christmas, the Bunkers decide to travel west for the holidays.

Jeffrey Tate conducts the English Chamber Orchestra in a performance of Mozart's Jupiter Symphony No. 41; the symphony is the last of a set of three that Mozart composed in rapid succession during the summer of 1788.
A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.
Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all the great composer's sixteen string quartets.

programmes.t: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programmes.d: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.
All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.
Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 5-8); recorded at St. Luke's, London.

programmes.t: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programmes.d: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.
A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.
In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.
Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.
Police solve a murder when divers find a skeleton in a car at the bottom of a river, and a dead dog's DNA helps crack open a 6-year-old case.

Work of an Alberta, Canada detective finally pays off when he tracks down the man who murdered a 6-year-old girl 10 years earlier. And when police search for the killer of a hitchhiker, they find that the victim's diary is one of their best clues.
The longest-running cold case of a law enforcement officer in the United States was the murder of Sheriff's Lt. Joe Clark.
