programmes.d: Rubble and the pups work to build a big bike shop in time for the Bike Festival, unless Speed Meister beats them to it; when Motor won't take a bath before their family photo, it's up to Rubble and the pups to find a construction solution.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Splash Park; The Crew Builds a Playroom
programmes.d: The pups have to get creative to cool down; the crew builds a playroom for Lucas and Lily, but a visitor causes complications.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds an Observatory; The Crew Builds a Zipline
programmes.d: The pups jump into action to build an observatory to help their friend River get a cool picture of a shooting star; after meeting Park Ranger Rose, the pups get stuck on a nature trail, but with Rubble & Crew, there's always a solution.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Library Tea Shop; The Crew Builds a Dance Floor
programmes.d: Construction on the first Builder Cove library is abuzz with bees; Grandpa Gravel teaches Charger all his best moves for the big dance contest.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds an Indoor Skydiving Center; The Crew Builds a Roller Rink
programmes.d: Mayor Greatway and Mr. Ducky-Doo want to show their skydiving skills; when wind gets in the way, the pups help them skydive on the ground; when Wheeler and Truffles the pig can't ice skate, the crew finds a construction.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Post Office; The Crew Builds a Farm Animal Wash
programmes.d: Builder Cove needs a post office but when construction gets squirrely, it's up to the pups to find a construction solution; using construction skills to convert the super car wash and clean Farmer Zoe's extra muddy animals.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Hotel; The Crew Builds a Hiking Trail
programmes.d: Builder Cove gets its first hotel when Farmer Zoe's brother Hadley comes to visit; after a hiking trail sign mix-up confuses everyone going to Mr. Ducky-Doo's birthday party, Rubble and Crew help them get back on track.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Reuse-It Station; The Crew Builds a Duck Bridge
programmes.d: When Speed Meister builds his own station for reusing trash, the pups have to clean up the mess all over Builder Cove; after a baby duckling follows them home, Rubble & Crew use their construction know-how to bring the duckling back to its home.

programmes.st: The Crew and Rocky Build a Bear Island
programmes.d: Rocky visits Rubble and Crew from Adventure Bay just in time to see Builder Cove's new baby bear; when Park Ranger Rose asks for construction help, Speed Meister accidentally ruins the bears' home.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Ballpark; The Crew Builds a Surf Bridge
programmes.d: When Rubble's favorite baseball star Aaron Judge can't get out of town to the home run derby, Rubble & Crew build a stadium to hold the derby right in Builder Cove; Surf's up for Rubble & Crew, if they can get over the super hot sand.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Kangaroo Safari; The Crew Plays in the Construction Games
programmes.d: Rubble and Crew build a kangaroo safari for Lucas and Lily right in the back yard until their construction kangaroo hops away; Speed Meister challenges Rubble and crew to compete in the ultimate build-off, builder Cove's first construction games.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds A Rooftop Stage; The Crew Fixes the Lighthouse
programmes.d: When Grocer Gabriel and Sierra Sparkle both need construction help before Banana Day, Rubble and Crew have their paws full; Speed Meister shines his face in the sky with the lighthouse, but when a ship needs that light, the pups jump into action.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Solar-Powered Bus; The Crew Builds a Lifeguard Tower
programmes.d: When Speed Meister steals Rubble and Crew's bus, the pups have to stop it in time for Sierra Sparkle's big concert; if Rubble and Crew build a lifeguard tower, the beach can open.

programmes.st: The Crew Builds a Playground; The Crew Fixes a Roof
programmes.d: After Speed Meister builds an unsafe playground, Rubble & Crew get creative and build a new one with old materials; the town Chili Cookaroo is threatened when City Hall's roof starts to cave in; luckily, the pups know just how to fix it.

programmes.st: The Crew and Marshall Build a Fire Station
programmes.d: Rubble & Crew build Builder Cove's first ever Fire Station, complete with an inspection from PAW Patrol's Marshall; when Speed Meister's sneaky sabotage traps Marshall's Fire Truck, the pups work together to put out a fire construction-style.

Timmy's parents find Poof and are convinced that he is an alien super baby; Jorgen takes Timmy to a rehabilitation facility to get him to learn to wish less and be more independent.

programmes.st: King Chang; The End of the Universe-ity

programmes.d: After Timmy wishes for a talking car, he goes on an adventure in Fairy World with Wanda, Poof and "Carsmo"; Timmy convinces Cosmo and Wanda to give him his own magic wand with 10 wishes on it.
Timmy convinces the fairies, anti-fairies and pixies to participate in a competition to see who is best.

programmes.d: Timmy goes to the hospital to have his tonsils removed; Timmy wishes to see his favorite baseball team.
Timmy offers to baby-sit so that Cosmo and Wanda can have a night out; Timmy wishes for indestructible hair.

programmes.d: Timmy, Cosmo and Wanda find themselves trapped in a bedtime story; Timmy wishes that a substitute teacher could be his permanent teacher.

programmes.d: Timmy must stay with Grandpa Pappy while his parents are out of town; Timmy finds his father's favorite childhood book series.
Timmy wishes he were a fish; Timmy wishes for a device that would allow him to change places with anyone.
Timmy wishes for a scholarship to military school; Timmy's father tries to help him with his homework.
Timmy wishes for the perfect older brother; Timmy wishes that everything in school were mixed up like a puzzle book.
Wanda must run the family business when Big Daddy is kidnapped; Timmy wishes his mother could sell a house to anyone.
In order for Sprig Speevak to become a space hero, he must first survive the perils of space high school.

programmes.d: Timmy wishes for super magician powers to perform at the fair; Timmy, Cosmo and Wanda are invited to a party at Cupid's house.
Timmy wishes the trash away; Timmy becomes the subject of a reality show.

programmes.st: Remy Rides Again; Hassle in the Castle
programmes.d: Remy wants Timmy to be his best friend; Timmy sneaks into the castle in Cosmo and Wanda's fishbowl.

programmes.st: Back to Norm; Teeth for Two
programmes.d: Mr. Crocker receives the magic lava lamp as a present; Jorgen plans to use Timmy's tooth as an engagement ring for the Tooth Fairy.

programmes.d: Everyone that Timmy cares about vanishes; Cosmo must receive a gland transplant.

programmes.st: Timmy's 2D House of Horror; It's a Wishful Life

programmes.d: Wanda visits her successful twin sister, Blonda; Timmy helps Mark Chang celebrate the Yugopotamian holiday FLARG.

programmes.st: The Time Limit Closes in! The Bond Between the Mink Tribe and the Crew!
programmes.d: In the aftermath of Jack's deadly attack on the island of Zou, Chopper and Sanji rush in to save the fallen Mink Tribe - but they will need the help of Caesar to overcome the poisonous effects of the gas!

programmes.st: The Delinquent Comes Home! Emperor Big Mom's Assassins!
programmes.d: More of the dramatic happenings on Zou are revealed as we learn that Jack's pirate band were not the only visitors to the elephant island! And what about the mysterious fate of Sanji?

programmes.st: The Truth Behind the Disappearance! Sanji Gets a Startling Invitation!
programmes.d: The mystery of Sanji's disappearance deepens as Luffy learns that Big Mom's lackeys have caught up with him and the rest - and carry with them an invitation from Big Mom that simply can't be refused!

programmes.st: To My Buds! Sanji's Farewell Note!
programmes.d: Sanji's dire situation has become clear, but instead of rallying against Big Mom's crew, he submits to go along with them to bring an end to this situation. But being separated from one of his crew is more than Luffy is willing to tolerate!

programmes.st: Let's Go and Meet Master Cat Viper!
programmes.d: There's only one key to finding out what happened to Sanji - and Luffy and the others make their way towards finding out more about their friend's disappearance, but on their way the indigenous fauna give them trouble!

programmes.st: Luffy's Decision! Sanji on the Brink of Quitting!
programmes.d: Luffy hatches a plan to help Sanji, but he'll have to go alone to avoid an all-out war with Big Mom. Meanwhile, Kin'emon and Kanjuro finally arrive at Zou, unwittingly setting the stage for the Minks' thirst for revenge!

programmes.st: A Volatile Situation! The Dog and the Cat and the Samurai!
programmes.d: The samurai have landed! And they make their way into the country of Zou unaware of the welcome they will receive by the Minks!

programmes.st: The Third One! Raizo of the Mist, the Ninja, Appears!
programmes.d: Revelations abound as the true nature of the Wano clan and their relationship with the Minks is revealed! Momonosuke's role is greater than any had imagined! But even more shocking - the visage of Raizo the Ninja!

programmes.st: A Red Stone! A Guide to the One Piece!
programmes.d: The mysteries of ninjutsu enthrall the Straw Hats as Raizo, the implausible ninja, makes his true powers known! Meanwhile, a mysterious artifact points the way towards the end of the Grand Line!

programmes.st: The Secret of the Land of Wano! The Kozuki Family and the Ponegliffs!
programmes.d: The mystery of the Ponegliffs is revealed - their true significance, and the story of their creation, leads closer to the Straw Hats than they might have imagined!

programmes.st: A Vow Between Two Men! Luffy and Kozuki Momonosuke!
programmes.d: More mysteries of the Kozuki Clan are revealed - and the samurai propose an alliance to help topple Kaido! But Luffy's response will shock the crew... and force the young daimyo to take responsibility!

programmes.st: The Legendary Journey! The Dog and the Cat and the Pirate King!
programmes.d: Dogstorm and Cat Viper share their story of being on the journey with Oden and Roger but are interrupted by Nami who is concerned about the sea route. Meanwhile, Jack is plotting to bring down the Mokomo Dukedom again!

programmes.st: The Nightmare Returns! The Invincible Jack's Fierce Attack!
programmes.d: The plans are set! The Straw Hats divide and conquer, one group heading to save Sanji, the others to the Land of Wano! But in the final moments before their departure, the tremendous elephant island begins to quake!

programmes.st: A Battle to Defend Zou! Luffy and Zunesha!
programmes.d: After being aggressively attacked by Jack's fleet, the monstrous Zunesha comes to life and beckons to those on its back! But can the Straw Hats understand its cry? And realize in time what the elephant island needs from them?

programmes.st: Save Zunesha! The Straw Hat's Rescue Operation!
programmes.d: With the skirmish with Jack now over, the Straw Hats move on to trying to bandage the great elephant's wounds! But just as the whole island puts the plan into action, unseen danger lurks on horizon!

programmes.st: Saying Goodbye and Descending from the Elephant! Setting Out to Take Back Sanji!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats and the others split up into four teams, each on different missions! Some from the Mink Tribe insist on leaving with Luffy's team! Meanwhile, Usopp makes a weapon for Nami that seems to work like magic!

programmes.st: To the Reverie! Princess Vivi and Princess Shirahoshi!
programmes.d: Luffy's team sets out from Zou on their way to win back Sanji! But they didn't realize there is one more crewmember than they have bargained for!

programmes.st: To the Reverie! Rebecca and the Sakura Kingdom!
programmes.d: Carrot stows away! And settles in with the Straw Hats as they make their way to rescue Sanji! Meanwhile, in the Sakura Kingdom, Dalton and Kureha are getting ready for the Reverie so as their former enemy in his newly-built kingdom…

programmes.st: Kaido Returns! An Imminent Threat to the Worst Generation!
programmes.d: News of the raid on the Revolutionary Army reaches Luffy! But that's the least of their worries as they face a storm and a sudden lack of provisions! Meanwhile, Emperor Kaido fumes with anger at the reckless generation of upstarts!

programmes.st: A Hungry Front! Luffy and the Navy Rookies!
programmes.d: Sneaking in to the Navy island facility to replenish their food supply, Luffy and the others risk being caught out in the open! Will their infamy make them easy to spot by the hotheaded Navy recruits around them?

programmes.st: The Implacable Three! A Big Chase After the Straw Hats!
programmes.d: The jig is up as Luffy and the others make a daring dash to avoid the furious Navy! Can they escape without having to turn to fight - and after they've had a chance to raid the cabinets for food?

programmes.st: The Devil's Fist! A Show Down! Luffy vs. Grount!
programmes.d: Making a mad dash for the Submerge with the food they stole, Luffy and the others have to get through some of the Navy's upstart soldiers! Grount, whose arm holds incredible power, summons his training to challenge Luffy!

Sanji faces Page One, a Headliner of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, who questions the soba cook's true identity. Sanji uses Germa's device for the first time and transforms himself into Stealth Black while dubbing himself Soba Mask.

programmes.st: A Desperate Situation! Orochi's Menacing Oniwabanshu!
programmes.d: While the banquet grows livelier at Orochi's Castle, Robin is confronted by his ninja force called Oniwabanshu. In the meanwhile in Kuri, Chopper, Tama, and Momonosuke train themselves preparing for the incoming battle.

programmes.st: Pandemonium! The Monster Snake, Shogun Orochi!
programmes.d: At the banquet, the Shogun Orochi starts to talk about his late old enemy which bores the attendees. Suddenly, the Oiran's child attendant Toko bursts with laughter and won't stop. Orochi becomes furious and attacks her.

programmes.st: The Flower Falls! The Final Moment of the Most Beautiful Woman in the Land of Wano!
programmes.d: In order to save her child attendant Toko, the top Oiran Komurasaki stands up to the Shogun Orochi, but the yakuza boss Kyoshiro interrupts and does something that no one expected.

programmes.st: The Bond Between Prisoners! Luffy and Old Man Hyo!
programmes.d: Nami, Robin, and the others got away from Oden's Castle and now discuss what they have found out about the enemy so far. Meanwhile, Chopper's group sets off to rescue Luffy from the Excavation Labor Camp.

programmes.st: A Lead Performer! Queen the Plague Emerges!
programmes.d: At the Excavation Labor Camp in Udon, Luffy tries to save Old Man Hyo and stands up to Vice Warden Daifuku and Warden Babanuki with his physical strength weakened by the Sea Prism Stone cuffs.
Luffy and Old Man Hyo try to climb up the wall and break out of the Excavation Labor Camp, but Queen the Plague stands in their way and gives them a hard time!

programmes.st: Dead or Alive! Queen's Sumo Inferno!
programmes.d: Luffy fights quite a few Queen's men at once in the deadly sumo match while protecting Old Man Hyo! Meanwhile, Nami, Robin, and Shinobu are cornered as Hawkins comes to raid the bathhouse.

programmes.st: Gyukimaru! Zoro Fights a Duel on Bandit's Bridge!
programmes.d: Luffy deals with the endless supply of opponents trying to figure out the way to use Haki that Rayleigh taught him a while ago. Meanwhile, Zoro faces Gyukimaru who is accusing him of stealing Shusui.

programmes.st: A Big Turnover! The Three-Sword Style Overcomes Danger!
programmes.d: The duel between Zoro and Gyukimaru is interrupted by Kamazo, Orochi's assassin who came after a little girl Toko. Without Shusui, Zoro has a hard time fighting the two at the same time, but he finds an unlikely third sword to take down the enemies.

programmes.st: Zoro, Stunned! The Shocking Identity of the Mysterious Woman!
programmes.d: Luffy's next enemies in the deadly sumo match in the Excavation Labor Camp are two tough Gifters. Much to Old Man Hyo's surprise, Luffy keeps practicing using Haki properly at the same time as he fights them.
A local beauty queen is found dead in a lake; as her small town grieves, law enforcement finds itself on a 20-plus year investigation that leads to a killer who was hiding in plain sight.
An apartment fire proves to be arson set to cover up the murder of a young woman, but the discovery of a secret double life and unique evidence leads detectives to the killer.

A witness comes face to face with the killer of a small-town beautician, but despite having an eyewitness, it would take years and a surprise tip to lead detectives to who strangled a beloved member of the community.

When a 4-year-old finds his great-grandparents melted, he runs for help, launching an investigation into their double murder; greed takes center stage as detectives unwind this heart-wrenching case that leads them to a suspect no one saw coming.

A young woman disappears, leaving the community hoping for her safe return; when she is found murdered, a string of mysterious anonymous tips takes detectives into a toxic world of jealousy and obsession.
A missing persons case becomes something much darker when a sick, sinister affair is uncovered, leading investigators to believe foul play is involved.

The mysterious shooting of a restaurateur with no solid suspects and no murder weapon leaves detectives in a lurch, but when financial motives come to light, an undercover operation and clever forensic investigation turn the case upside-down.

After their brother is convicted of murder, three siblings hatch a deadly plot to avenge him by targeting the star witness in his trial; the plan goes awry when the wrong person is on the receiving end of their vengeance.

Twin sisters, raised with a deep disdain for law enforcement, are arrested for shooting a neighbor's dog, then escape custody and go on the run, leading to one of the deadliest shootouts in Colorado history.

Raised in a strict home, Matthew and Tyler believe it's their duty to cleanse the world of those living in sin; when two men are found dead, the brother's connection to them points toward a hateful trail of crime.

Sheltered teenage brothers Robert and Michael Bever idolize serial killers and dream of being the most prolific murderers in history; with an arsenal of weapons, their quest for notoriety begins at home in their quiet Oklahoma suburb.

The Carr brothers arrive in Wichita, Kan., intending to commit robberies, but their plans quickly escalate to a murderous spree the likes of which Kansas had never seen; their reign of terror becomes known as the "Wichita Massacre."

After a man is found brutally murdered inside his own bar, a murder mystery unfolds over the span of years; detectives believe it's a business deal gone bad and must remain steadfastly dedicated to the case after hitting several dead ends.
In the summer of 1991, a pair of half-siblings creates panic across southern California when they embark on a spree of random crimes of the worst kind, targeting people out doing everyday tasks.

Over a brutal 7-month stretch, a trio of brothers commit a series of increasingly violent crimes across the city of Richmond, leaving behind a growing body count; even after their apprehension, these brothers prove difficult to contain.

A pair of larger-than-life identical twins commit a series of brutal attacks in a small Tennessee town; with each crime, the brothers grow more emboldened; as time goes on and with little evidence against them, there's no telling how far they'll go.

When a correctional officer is murdered, it seems like an act of vengeance, but a love triangle is exposed; after learning his wife is having an affair, a husband plans to kill her lover and enlists the help of his brothers to carry out the task.

A missing persons case spirals down a winding path once detectives learn that a formerly beloved older brother appears to have embezzled money from the family's business; his siblings are hellbent on getting revenge.

In one of the most tragic and brutal crimes in the history of the Great Plains, five teens playing by a campfire are ambushed by a trio of shotgun-wielding brothers; a lone survivor bravely helps detectives hunt down her assailants.
An immigrant family's American dream turns into a nightmare when a devious sister manipulates her younger valedictorian brother into committing murder; a dark family secret comes to light.

Five-O searches for missing Lord Charles Danby and unmasks a British intelligence agent Harry Wells in search of Danby. Wells' mission is to stop Danby from passing secrets to a communist, but McGarrett suspects Wells' identity & purpose.

After Curt Anderson, a man with gambling connections, is found murdered in his Honolulu apartment, Steve McGarrett and his Five-O team hunt for a female courier for a Las Vegas casino and discover that a hit man is racing to beat them to her.

McGarrett was tried for murder by dangerous convicts led by enemy Honore Vashon after surrendering for hostages' release. Vashon, seeking revenge, intends to execute McGarrett, but McGarrett has doubt of Vashon's true motives.
After discovering that a grisly murder scene was staged, the team realizes that Abby was the intended target when some key evidence contaminates her lab and almost kills her.

Ziva is in shock when a routine tactic she uses to subdue a suspect might be the cause of his sudden death. As Ducky and Abby work to clear Ziva's name, Gibbs learns that Director Shepard has been kidnapped by their dead suspect's brother.
The members of NCIS are distressed when Gibbs is injured in a terrorist explosion while on assignment.

As the team tries to track down the terrorists behind the bombing that injured Gibbs, they learn that the terrorist group is planning another bombing of 9-11 magnitude--and that Gibbs has information about their plan.

Secret Service agent Mike Banning finds himself trapped inside the White House in the wake of a terrorist attack and works to rescue the President from his kidnappers.

programmes.d: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.

The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to have revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.
Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.
Sydney has a connection to the Rambaldi notebook.
FBI Special Officer Kendall questions Sydney.
Sydney is reunited with an SD-6 agent she dated.
Vaughn confirms K-Directorate has hired an assassin to kill Khasinau.
Sydney and Vaughn are sent in to meet with Mr. Sark.
Dixon is sent to steal pages of a Rambaldi manuscript.

After a young girl is kidnapped from her daycare, the team must help her parents navigate a debt owed to the deadly gang in their neighborhood. Also, Maggie struggles to focus on the case when her sister, Erin, returns from rehab.

The team attempts to extract key information from a vulnerable 9/11 widow,Hannah Thompson (Janel Moloney),who is shocked that her new "boyfriend" is the manipulative leader of a terrorist group planning an attack.

After Rina is critically wounded while heading to work with Jubal; the team makes the chilling discovery that a vengeful Vargas orchestrated the shooting from behind bars and continues to target the rest of their team and their loved ones.
As the team investigates a string of jewelry store robberies that culminate in a double murder,they uncover a connection to a 16-year-old boy trying to survive the foster care system.
As the team searches for an abducted college co-ed,Jubal becomes intent on obtaining lifesaving leads from the father of the abductor's previous victim.
A group of assassins targets the gang, forcing Michael to go on the offensive in the Season 6 finale.

Under deep cover in the Dominican Republic, Michael works as part of the deal he made with the CIA. A notorious underground terrorist named Burke recruits him to steal sensitive equipment from a secure defense facility.
Michael returns to Miami to preserve his cover, but Strong puts a damper on his homecoming by forbidding Michael from contacting his friends.

Sam and Jesse travel to the Dominican Republic after Michael asks for their help with a high-stakes trade involving an international bomber. Meanwhile, Fiona must intervene when a cutthroat bookie tries to extort Madeline for an unpaid debt.

As Michael tries to uncover details about Burke’s underground network, he and his team receive an assignment to break a prisoner out of a Russian black site in Cuba. To assist, Fiona and Madeline work to frame a corrupt Russian bureaucrat for treason.
Michael joins forces with a former Russian operative working in Burke's organization to escape Cuba; Strong tries to convince Fiona to help Michael.
Recently released from prison, Cyrus Vanch (David Anders) returns to rule Starling City's underworld. But first he must take down his biggest opponent—Arrow.
After Oliver is shot, he turns to Felicity for help. Together, she and Diggle team up to save Oliver's life as he hovers between life and death.
Oliver asks Detective McKenna Hall on a date, while a jewel thief named Dodger (James Callis) strikes Starling City and targets someone close to Oliver.
Oliver and Diggle learn that Deadshot (Michael Rowe) is still alive—and his next target is Malcolm (recurring guest star John Barrowman).
With his nightclub opening and new romance with McKenna, Oliver's happiness is interrupted by the return of The Huntress, threatening to destroy everything he cares about.
An angry resident of The Glades who calls himself "The Savior" (Christopher Redman) embarks on a kidnapping and killing spree inspired by Arrow's vigilantism.
When The Count (Seth Gabel) escapes from the mental institution and the city is flooded with Vertigo-related violence, Oliver and Diggle make it their mission to track him down.
Deadshot returns to Starling City, and Diggle's determined to see his brother's killer dead—with or without Oliver's help.
When Felicity discovers a lead that might lead to Walter's whereabouts, Oliver gambles that Felicity can be counted on in the field for the first time.

programmes.st: Darkness on the Edge of Town
programmes.d: With the Undertaking only days away, Malcolm dons his black hood, while Oliver must outwit and/or outfight the Dark Archer in order to save the city.
In the epic season finale, Oliver & Diggle race to stop the Dark Archer from unleashing his vengeance on The Glades, while Oliver & Tommy's relationship takes a turn for the worse.
In the season two premiere, Diggle and Felicity travel to Lian Yu to convince Oliver to return home to Starling City, where he finds things much worse than he imagined.
When medicine for Glades Memorial Hospital is being hijacked by thieves, Oliver gets into a heated battle with China White and her new partner, the Bronze Tiger, over the supplies.
When a dangerous criminal from Lance's past (Michael Eklund) escapes from prison, Felicity offers herself up as bait so Arrow, Diggle, and Lance can capture him… but plans go awry.
When an illegal gun-runner who goes by the name "The Mayor" (Cle Bennett) seriously injures Sin (Bex Taylor-Klaus), The Canary (Caity Lotz) sets out for revenge.
While Oliver tends to the Canary's wounds, he tries to get her to talk. But when they're both attacked by the League of Assassins, she confesses that she's connected.
Diggle heads to Russia to follow a lead on Deadshot (Michael Rowe) in Moscow.  When Oliver and Felicity decide to join him, things get complicated when Isabel shows up as well.
The Super Fight tournament kicks off while Genos takes on multiple monsters who have appeared in City C.

When Jennifer learns that the guys have nothing planned for Adam's last weekend as a bachelor, she plans a party weekend.  Things don't go as planned, however, so Jeff, Russell, and Timmy must improvise.
Audrey has always had suspicions that Jeff's old college friend Heidi harbours romantic feelings for him, so Jeff invites Heidi over to prove that this was never the case.

Brenda goes into labor on Jen and Adam's wedding day, but Jeff has reservations about being in the delivery room. Adam persuades Jen to make some alternative arrangements for their marriage ceremony.

Adam and Jennifer are a 20-something couple who have gotten engaged and moving in together after just seven months of dating. Meanwhile, their neighbors Jeff and Audrey who have been married for twelve years try to set a good example.
Though he's unhappy that Audrey spent more than usual for his birthday party, Jeff wants to stay on her good side to ensure he gets his yearly birthday deal. Though Jeff won't reveal the 'deal.'

After Adam has too many restless nights sleeping in Jennifer’s small bed, he brings home the bed he shared with his ex-girlfriend which causes a fight and leads them tossing out all memories of past relationships.

Jennifer tries to help Jeff’s sore neck with a massage until the situation between them becomes uncomfortable and upsets Audrey. Meanwhile, Russell brings Adam along to help him fight off a school yard bully so Russell can get close to the teacher.

Adam and Jennifer’s plans for a romantic weekend fall apart after they argue about their different feelings toward careers, finances, and kids. Meanwhile, Audrey is having second thoughts about why she and Jeff have waited so long to have children.
After Adam buys an expensive video-game console, Jennifer makes him promise to discuss major purchases first, but Russell interferes and makes Adam question the agreement.

Roy hires bodyguards to keep the riff-raff away at an auction in Brampton. Bogart quits, but just when he thinks he's out can Paul pull him back in? Rick and Cindy make a wicked-awesome discovery, and Ursula gets carried away.

Roy's arch-nemesis, auctioneer Patrick Pecker, calls an auction on Weston Road. While Roy seeks to lift the curse, Ursula works her charm. Meanwhile, Bogart reads Paul the riot-shirt, and Rick and Cindy get lost.

programmes.st: Who Wants To Be A Bazillionaire
programmes.d: Ursula's new employee Tania is tough, goth, and not afraid to pick fights at auctions in Toronto. Of course, Cindy isn't about to back down. When Bogart decides to assert himself, he threatens Roy's claim to the title of biggest jerk at the auction.

Part-time janitors Mike and Armando hope to clean up at an auction in Emery Village. Rick and Cindy don't want more newbies but Paul is always looking out to replace Bogart. Roy can't handle the tooth but Ursula's locker is totally tubular.

Buying partnerships are tested at an auction in Brampton. Bogart puts Paul on a diet. Meanwhile, Rick squirms when Cindy wants him to wear a spiffy new shirt. Ursula tries on her bossy-pants, but what Roy finds really puts the icing on the cake.

programmes.st: Keep Your Friends Close And The Veterans Closer
programmes.d: Paul and Bogart declare storage war on the veterans at an auction in Orillia. Roy bums a ride off them instead. Ursula has a bad hair day, and Rick and Cindy meet former Stanley Cup Champion Nick Kypreos.

Roy is up to his usual antics at an auction in the Old Weston neighborhood of Toronto but this time Ursula strikes back. Paul and Bogart are the epitome of the blind leading the blind, while Rick and Cindy's locker is more than meets the eye.

Paul and Bogart concoct an entirely new strategy for an auction in Leaside: to have no strategy at all. Rick and Cindy play doctor, Ursula gets her geek on, and Roy rocks out with Canadian metal icon Robb Reiner.

Ursula hopes her pet chinchilla will bring her luck at an auction in East Gwillimbury, but little Monty has ideas of his own. Rick and Cindy get into watersports, Paul and Bogart make a virtue of chastity, and Roy comes to work in his pajamas.

Tensions run high between Roy and Ursula at an auction in Thornhill. Roy brings his dog for support and Ursula does her best to ignore them. Paul and Bogart hope their life coach will give them a leg up, and Cindy can't hear a word anyone is saying.

Paul and Bogart swore never to bring Bogart's sisters to another auction, which is why Roy brings them to one in Cambridge. Rick and Cindy try getting lucky with some models, while Ursula hopes magician Zack Mirza can make money materialize.

programmes.st: Roy Dimbeck: The Roy Dimbeck Story
programmes.d: After months of waiting for Cindy to set a wedding date, Rick makes a bold move at an auction in Mississauga. Roy records his memoirs for bidding posterity. Ursula finds a new place to stash her booze, and Paul and Bogart get conched on the head.
Digging deeper than ever before, the Laginas and their team find evidence of previously unknown structures in the Money Pit. While in the swamp, Gary strikes gold.
While searching the spoils excavated from the Money Pit area, Alex Lagina discovers evidence of human activity deep underground, dating back to 1492.

As the team follows the trajectory of the mysterious stone pathway in the swamp, they discover an elusive piece of Oak Island lore. And Gary uncovers evidence suggesting a treasure was, or is, nearby.
While seeking a cure for a fever ravaging the Enterprise, Kirk and Spock encounter Flint, a hermit-like Earthman, and his beautiful young ward.
The Enterprise picks up a group of space "hippies" looking for Eden.
To acquire the resources to cure a space plague, Kirk must resolve a mining dispute between the cultural elites of the cloud city of Stratos and the miners on the surface.
Kirk and Spock meet Abraham Lincoln and Surak of Vulcan and must battle with some of history's most terrible villains.
Kirk, Spock, and McCoy enter a time portal and get stuck in the past on a planet about to be consumed by a nova.
The Enterprise is in danger when Janice Lester, one of Kirk's former lovers, steals his body.
Kirk and his crew are at deadly risk from an alien creature that feeds on the salt in a human body and can take on any form.
A powerful teenage boy wreaks havoc aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

programmes.st: Where No Man Has Gone Before
programmes.d: Kirk's friend, Gary Mitchell, is transformed into a God-like entity.
A strange alien substance causes the crew to act out their deepest inhibitions, while the ship plummets out of orbit.

A transporter malfunction causes Captain Kirk to split into his "good" and "evil" selves, and a landing party will freeze to death if the crew is unable to find a way to merge the two Kirks back together.
The Enterprise picks up a intergalactic conman, Harry Mudd, and three incredibly beautiful women who harbor a dark secret.

programmes.st: What Are Little Girls Made Of?
programmes.d: Nurse Christine Chapel is reunited with her old fiancé on Exo III, but the scientist has plans for Captain Kirk and the Federation.
A strange group of children are discovered on an Earth-like planet.
Kirk investigates an experimental facility for holding prisoners and finds a sinister scheme.
Kirk bluffs his way past what appears to be a powerful alien.
Spock hijacks the Enterprise to return an injured Captain Pike to Talos IV.
After their ship is destroyed, Sisko is stranded on a distant planet with an increasingly disturbed Dukat.
Quark inherits a fortune -and a group of thieves lay claims to the estate.
Hidden on a shrunken Runabout, Dax, O'Brien, and Bashir are Sisko's only hope when the Jem'Hadar overtake the Defiant.
Sisko envisions he is a science-fiction writer encountering racism in 1953 America.
An undercover operation turns personal for O'Brien when he befriends his criminal contact.
When Dax is seriously injured during a crucial mission, Worf must question his priorities.

programmes.st: Wrongs Darker Than Death or Night
programmes.d: Kira learns that her mother was once Gul Dukat's mistress.
An internal investigation indicates Doctor Bashir may be a Dominion spy.
Sisko attempts to trick the Romulans into declaring war against the Dominion.
Odo receives lessons in romancing Kira from a holographic 1960's lounge singer.
Sisko must risk his son's life to fulfill his role as the Emissary.
Jake and Nog are rescued by an elite group of Starfleet cadets on a secret mission.
When Grand Nagus Zek is deposed, Quark poses as a female to help him regain his power.
An accident turns O'Brien's eight-year-old daughter into a wild, dangerously un-socialized eighteen-year-old.
Sisko and the crew race to save a Starfleet captain stranded alone on an oxygen-starved planet.
Ignoring the warnings of the Prophets, Sisko leads an invasion into Dominion territory.
With the wormhole closed, Sisko struggles to find a way to re-establish contact with the Bajoran Prophets.
Archer and T'Pol travel back in time to 2004 Detroit to stop a Xindi plot.
Religious zealots hijack Enterprise to use it as a weapon against the enemies of their faith.
An Andorian ship led by Commander Shran arrives in the Delphic Expanse to help Enterprise hone in on the Xindi superweapon.
Archer finds himself face-to-face with Degra, the designer of the Xindi superweapon, and tries to trick him into revealing its location.
As Archer tries to unravel the mystery of a rescued alien, long-simmering feelings explode among his senior officers.
The fate of Enterprise is in Dr. Phlox's hands as the rest of the crew must be induced into a coma in order to survive a trans-dimensional disturbance.
Archer goes to extreme lengths to save an abandoned nest of Xindi-Insectoid eggs ready to hatch.
Archer sets out on a suicide mission to destroy the Xindi superweapon as Enterprise faces a brutal attack.
While dissension grows among Xindi ranks, Enterprise tries to recover from a devastating attack.
Two high-ranking Xindi offer to stop the launch of their superweapon if Archer can prove they've been manipulated. Meanwhile, the crew mourns their lost mates.
An attempt to use a Xindi subspace corridor leads the Enterprise crew to a bizarre encounter with their own descendants.
Archer and Hoshi stand before the Xindi Council as T'Pol and Reed lead a team into the heart of a Sphere.
With help from Xindi allies, the Enterprise crew attempts to stop the arming of the superweapon aimed toward Earth.
Archer puts his life on the line in a risky gambit to intercept the Xindi superweapon and disarm it from within.
Archer and the NX-01 find themselves in Earth's past, with events of World War II altered by the Temporal Cold War.
With Silik's help, Archer hones in on the temporal operative who altered Earth's past and threatens to destroy all of time.
Once the NX-01 finally returns to Earth, the weary crewmen face repercussions of their journeys, both positive and negative.
They call themselves the Borg – a half-machine collective with a sole purpose: to conquer and assimilate all races.
When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!
Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.
They call themselves the Borg – a half-machine collective with a sole purpose: to conquer and assimilate all races.
When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!
Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.

When Data resigns his commission rather than be dismantled for examination by an inadequately skilled scientist, a formal hearing is convened to determine whether Data is considered property without rights or is a sentient being.
Picard and the crew suffer from conflicting emotions when the Enterprise rescues a critically-injured Borg.

Responding to a distress call on one of the Federation's outer-most colonies, the Enterprise arrives...only to find a big hole in the ground where the town used to be, and discovers the Borg are behind the attack.
Commander Riker had no choice as acting captain but fire full force on the Borg starship, despite Picard being on board of it, altered to a Borg calling himself Locutus, both ships are damaged.

After defeating the Borg, the crew of the Enterprise experiences shore leave in various ways. Captain Picard's return to his family's vineyard in France has some extraordinary repercussions following his time spent as a member of the Borg collective.
The Enterprise visits the planet where Data was created and discovers another android like him, but when he's assembled, he's not EXACTLY like him.
Riker, Troi, Data and Yar beam down to a planet ruled by a matriarchal government in the hopes of locating a missing freighter crew.
The Enterprise docks at a starbase for repairs where it is commandeered by a race of technologically-linked aliens intent on using the vessel for their own purposes.
The Enterprise transports an elderly Starfleet Admiral to negotiate a hostage crisis. When the Admiral takes a de-aging drug, he endangers both his life and the mission.

A planet that was able to cloak itself for thousands of years suddenly reveals itself, with its inhabitants proposing peace. But, after initial negotiations, children of the Enterprise are kidnapped due to the impotence of the inhabitants.
On Velara III, Geordi and Data discover a microscopic life form responsible for the death of an engineer stationed on the base.

Picard finds himself facing a strenuous test of his loyalty to Starfleet, one which the other members of the crew are struggling to cope with, whilst Wesley faces an equally challenging entrance exam at Starfleet Academy.
The Enterprise searches for answers as to why three Klingon warriors were the only survivors aboard a freighter just inside the Neutral Zone which was seemingly attacked by a Ferengi ship.
The Enterprise encounters a planet long dead, but technical equipment still functions for the purpose of selling off its arsenal, along with self sufficiency.
The Enterprise encounters two neighboring cultures, one suffering from a plague, the other marketing a cure, and learn that nothing is as simple as it seems.
While en route back to the Enterprise, the shuttlecraft carrying Counselor Troi loses power and gets caught in a planet's gravity well.
The crew of the Enterprise races against time, itself, when a scientist experiments with time, and claims to have opened a window into another dimension, which must be closed.
Chakotay finds a planet of unassimilated Borg drones from all over the galaxy.
After the Doctor adds a mix of new sub-routines to his program, his personality turns violent.
The crew tries to help the inhabitants of a planet that's being bombarded by deadly asteroids.
Kim becomes convinced he's a native of Taresia, a planet inhabited primarily by women.
On her deathbed, Kes is bewildered when she begins reliving her life moving backwards in time.
While Paris makes a daring flight into a subspace energy storm, the Doctor experiences the joys and sorrows of family life.
An alien professor kidnaps Chakotay to prove his controversial theory about the origin of his species.
Voyager is pirated by an alien race, and her crew sent to an idyllic prison colony.
A holo-novel program about a Maquis mutiny becomes all too real when a holographic version of Seska enters the picture.
Faced with a more dangerous enemy than the Borg, Captain Janeway prepares to make a deal with the Devil.
While searching for a missing officer, Captain Kathryn Janeway and the crew of the Starship Voyager are swept 70,000 light years from home.
The Voyager crew launches a daring rescue mission to save two officers trapped in a subterranean city facing disaster.
Tensions rise between the merged Starfleet and Maquis crews when the ship becomes trapped inside a star that's collapsed upon itself.
When Paris and Janeway are sent back in time, they must decide whether to violate the Prime Directive by warning residents of a planet facing annihilation.
Neelix faces certain death when an alien race stricken by a devastating plague "harvests" his lungs.
The crew discovers that a nebula is not what it seems, and Paris invites his fellow officers to share a little "R&R" in his holodeck program.
The discovery of a wormhole in deep space raises the crew's hopes of finding a shortcut home.

Armed with the means to track Replicator ships, the Atlantis team strives to eliminate the Replicators once and for all. Now, the team rushes to evacuate those human settlements in the path of the advancing Replicator forces.

The Atlantis long-range sensors detect the signal of a subspace tracking device familiar to Dr. McKay. The team follows to signal to a damaged hive ship drifting in space. Amidst the ship’s records, they discover references to a secret Wraith base.

When an alarm sounds, McKay suspects that a highly infectious disease has triggered the city’s self-protection system. With vital systems affected, the Atlantis team finds themselves trapped in various sections of the city with no way out.

Wanting to maintain diplomatic relations, Sheppard and McKay accompany Harmony, a precocious young princess, on a mandatory rite of passage. However, they are unaware that she has enemies, and character flaws, yet to be dealt with.

When Lt. Colonel John Sheppard receives word that his father has passed away he returns to Earth. But once there, he becomes embroiled in a dangerous experiment gone awry—a human form Replicator now on the loose that must be recaptured at all cost.

During an off-world mission in a village rocked by fierce tremors, Col. Samantha Carter, Dr. McKay, and Dr. Keller become trapped when they fall into a sinkhole. But every attempt to escape the confines of the chamber puts them in further jeopardy.

With the Destiny still out of power, a plan is born to abandon the ship using the last working shuttle, in hopes that another planet will be habitable. But hope is short-lived when the only way to determine who will go and who will stay is a lottery.

Despite severe rationing and around-the-clock security, the water reserves onboard the Destiny continue to drop. Dr. Nicholas Rush has no explanation for this latest setback but, if they are to survive, they must find a new water source soon.

With the situation onboard the Destiny dire, General O’Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) and Homeworld Command order Col. Young to execute a high-risk plan concocted by the IOA scientists which, in theory, could return the crew to Earth.

After making a surprising discovery on a jungle planet, members of the team become ill. In an attempt to isolate the infection, the team sets up camp in the jungle. But when night falls, the illness will be the least of their worries.

Rogue NSA officers hijack the X-303 spaceship and demand that Adrian Conrad be brought to the ship. Using his Goa'uld knowledge, Conrad activates the X-303 and takes the ship light-years from Earth as O'Neill and Teal'c stage a daring rescues.

When SG-1 is marooned in deep space, Thor comes to the rescue. He then seek O'Neill's help to combat the Replicators. Convinced they will attack earth if not stopped, O'Neill stages a daring mission to stop the Replicators once and for all.

SG-1 returns from a mission with an artifact that triggers the ability to see hideous yet harmless life forms in a parallel reality. As the effect spreads to civilians, O'Neill and his team must find a solution before mass hysteria breaks out.

Senator Kinsey suffers an assassination attempt while campaigning for the presidency, and O'Neill is caught on tape leaving the building where the shots were fired. With O'Neill behind bars, Carter, Teal'c and Jonas must prove his innocence.

Colonel Maybourne visits O'Neill and claims to have a key to a cache of alien technology, but demands a presidential pardon in exchange for it. When SG-1 accompanies Maybourne to retrieve it, they find his intentions may not be all they seem.

SG-1 discovers that Nirrti is mutating the inhabitants of an unexplored planet with a machine that rearranges their DNA. Captured in an attempt to stop her, O'Neill must find a way to escape before he and SG-1 are subjected to the same fate.

General Hammond and the Pentagon are forced to reveal the existence of the Stargate to other world governments. Senator Kinsey suggests that General Hammond be relieved of his command and that the civilian-run NID oversee the Stargate program.

programmes.st: One Man's Trash... Is Lisa's Trash
programmes.d: The buyers head to Montebello, where there are a number of lockers for auction; Brandi has the resale market covered; Ivy mines his way into some vintage safety gear.
Darrell uncovers a macabre oddity; Dave finds an antique toy; Barry asks a member of the band Aerosmith for an appraisal.

Brandi shows up in Riverside, Calif., dressed to distract and it kind of works; Rene bites off more than even he can chew but rings up quite a bit, nonetheless; Barry and Kenny flip when they go through their unit.
In the desert climes of Lancaster, Calif., Nabila Haniss strikes it big while Dave Hester ends up feeling like a fifth wheel.

Kenny feels nostalgic in Koreatown, so he brings along an old friend, which may or may not be a good idea; Brandi and Jarrod sweeten their profit in an unexpected way; Ivy tolerates the big city in an effort to find some name-brand goodies.
The buyers seek hidden finds in Norwalk, Calif.; Mary arrives overly prepared for battle; Ivy turns his focus toward collectibles; Darrell devises a plan to escape the auction game forever.
Lancaster turns into Ivy's honeypot, so everyone had better watch out, or they might get stung; Lisa plans to use her brain when selecting lockers; Dusty and Tollbooth Lupe do a mitzvah.

The buyers have their worlds rocked in Garden Grove; Ivy learns that there are surprising uses for office equipment; Lisa finds the shiniest bowl she's ever seen; Dusty, getting a rise out of everyone, finds out the true meaning of being a jerk.

San Bernardino is full of surprises, particularly for Rene and Casey, who roll the dice on some sealed totes; Kenny stumbles over some odd-looking car parts; Lisa shields herself from disaster with an unusually expensive locker.
Mary launches a daring idea while Ivy keeps it old school and targets a working man's unit; Rene wants to focus on the lockers, but Dave gets in the way.
Back in Montebello, Gunter comes along to help Rene, who won't give him the time of day; Darrell tries to make Kimber his queen; Ivy and his boys Rochambeau their way to solid showing.
The buyers scour a hippie town for 1970s memorabilia; Barry uncovers a relic from his past; Darrell finds a medical device with profit potential.

Terribly worried when her beloved pets don't return home, Strawberry puts on a brave face so as not to worry her friends as they all search for the pets.
Orange's store is overflowing with Berrykin Bloom's new line of Berry Bitty Fruits & Veggies. Confident she can tackle any challenge, Orange tries to deal with everything herself.

Strawberry's new produce marketplace goes under construction. Strawberry is so grateful to her girlfriends for helping her with a new bedroom atop the marketplace, that she accommodates all their ideas and neglects to include her own!
Strawberry's friends surprise her by inviting her favorite singer, superstar Cherry Jam, to perform at the grand opening of the Marketplace.
When Cherry Jam plans a recital for her new music students, Plum experiences stage-fright for the first time, and tries to delay the event.

Berry Bitty City holds its first talent show. When the girls discover a talent scout will attend, Lemon decides she has to perform without any help from her friends, even though they are all helping each other.
Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions.
Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much-needed vacation.
When the girls learn their tropical island vacation is cancelled due to weather, Orange decides to build an exact replica of the resort at home.
Just as the girls are about to enjoy a vacation at their homemade resort, TV host Mavis Maraschino shows up to do a segment on Cherry Jam and disrupts their plans.
The beginning of winter brings a brief spell of springlike weather, ruining everyone's hopes for winter fun. With help from Strawberry, the community adapts to the changing conditions.
Blueberry's invention of parasol-powered ice skates is all the rage, landing her the opportunity to create her own musical commercial for them.

When both Raspberry and Berrykin Bruce plan spring-themed events for the same location, Strawberry helps them work out a compromise—they combine their efforts to create a spring fashion show around a water show.

The girls' new band is about to go on the road to a concert at Berry Big City. But first they must teach the Berrykins all about their businesses, so the little folk can keep the community running until the girls return.
On his way to Berry Big City to open a home for stray dogs, Huckleberry Pie’s Pet-Mobile gets stuck. He is rescued by Strawberry and her friends.
Blueberry entices Huckleberry to come for a visit by asking him to team up and write a mystery story for an online mystery magazine.

programmes.st: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programmes.d: When Huckleberry and Blueberry’s Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by the online mystery magazine, Strawberry comes up with a new way to raise funds for Huckleberry’s pet shelter—a big dog show!

Plum’s plan to direct a small, simple fairy tale play as a surprise performance for the Baby Berrykins snowballs out of control when she hears of the same play being done on a grand scale in a big city theater.
Drafted by the girls to play Prince Berry Charming in a community play, Huck pushes aside his reluctance and tries to not disappoint them.
Blueberry and Huckleberry pitch their new play, an adaptation of the Berrykin Kids’ favorite BerryFairyTale 'The Littlest Berrykin' to their friends.
A problem in the sparkleberry juice system that powers the entire town results in a repair crew of Berrykins invading the town with jackhammers.
A problem in the sparkleberry juice system that powers the town keeps the girls from doing their work—to the frustration of Cherry Jam, who is struggling to write a song.
Unable to sleep with the noise of an all-night construction crew of Berrykins trying to get the power turned back on, Strawberry and the girls go on a campout.
While building a new Dog Park, Huck finds the Good Luck Charm that Cherry wrongly believes gives her the ability to sing difficult notes.

The girls plan an elegant afternoon tea party to inaugurate the town’s new dog park, but encounter a mystery when the guests of honor, their puppies, strangely refuse to enter, and no one can figure out why.
Blueberry invites Huck to attend Berry Bitty City’s big Masquerade Ball in honor of their new dog park. A screwball comedy of errors ensues when Blueberry gets a cold and has to stay home.

programmes.st: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programmes.d: The girls decide to each bake Berrykin Bloom the perfect cupcake, to be presented at a ceremony honoring him for his achievements in Berryculture.
Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.
Strawberry's world-traveling cousin Apple Dumplin' stops at Berry Bitty City. What starts as a brief visit becomes a series of comical misadventures.
Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's 'mood hair' runs amok.
When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday.
When a comedy of errors causes Orange, Plum and Cherry to arrive late to their campout, they start off their annual tradition of telling tall-tales around the campfire.
At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the 'Berry Deep Dark Forest.'
Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling 'Tall Tales.'
Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City.
Sour teasing Apple escalates into a 'prank war' between the two of them.
Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.
Women's boxing icon Claressa Shields brings power, precision, and championship pedigree to MMA!
Relive the breakout performances of Mackenzie Dern during her LFA days, before she rose to the top of the UFC!
Olympic gold-medalist Kyla Ross competes in her first meet as a UCLA Bruin.
“The Unabombshell” Jennifer Tilly returns to defend her WPT Ladies’ Night crown.
High-flying aerobatics as elite athletes battle for gold in the ultimate trampoline showdown.
The 6th Energetic Center with Yoga and Meditation to awaken intuition, inspiration, and insight.

As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.
When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher.
A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.
Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert.

programmes.st: The Journey To BA Sing SE, Part 1: The Serpent's Pass
programmes.d: When the kids are prevented from taking the "easy way" into Ba Sing Se, they must escort a family of refugees there the hard way, through the deadly Serpent's Pass.

programmes.st: The Journey to BA Sing SE, Part 2: The Drill
programmes.d: Aang discovers a colossal Fire Nation invention heading for Ba Sing Se, and the kids must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.
Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them.
A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city.
In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen.
While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not.  Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.
The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city.
A guru at the Eastern Air Temple helps Aang take the next step in his Avatar journey.
Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister conquest of Ba Sing Se.
After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship.   Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.
To better camouflage themselves as real Fire Nation citizens, the kids check out a Fire Nation school.  Avatar dance special.  Also, Zuko confronts Uncle.
When the gang comes to a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.
When Sokka feels he’s not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.
Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation at Lo and Li’s beach house, where they learn a lot about themselves and each other.  Meanwhile, the kids face a new enemy.
Aang and Zuko are taken on parallel adventures that give them insight into their forefathers’ pasts – but how does the tale of Roku and Sozin matter to them now?
When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.
On the eve of the eclipse, Aang’s anxiety gets the better of him.  His dreams become nightmares, and soon he can no longer tell dream from reality.

programmes.st: Day of the Black Sun "The Eclipse" Part 1
programmes.d: With the Fire Nation on the brink of global domination, a young girl and her brother discover a 12-year old Airbender who reveals himself as the Avatar. Will this irresponsible kid accept his destiny in time to save the world?
Korra and company attempt to close the spirit portals before Harmonic Convergence.
Team Avatar travels to Ba Sing Se to search for Airbenders.
After discovering that the Earth Queen is forcing all the Airbenders in Ba Sing Se to join her army, Korra makes a plan to bust them out.
Korra's quest leads her and her friends to the metal city of Zaofu.
Beifong is forced to face her past.
Tenzin tries to train the new members of the Air Nation while dealing with Bumi's bad attitude.
Zaheer and his group attempt to abduct Korra.
Having mastered water, earth and fire, Avatar Korra is eager to begin her training in airbending, but trouble in Republic City interrupts her plans.
After hitting a snag in her airbending training with Master Tenzin, Korra pays a visit to the city's Pro Bending arena in search of inspiration.
Korra attempts to infiltrate the Equalist movement and learn more about its mysterious leader.
Korra is recruited to join Councilman Tarrlok's task force, which seeks to rid the city of Equalists by force.
Korra and her pro-bending teammates struggle to work together after romantic rivalries shake their foundation.

Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career.  However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo.  Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez.  Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Goes To School
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read.  When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector.  Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums.  When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programmes.d: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programmes.d: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house.  Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company.  Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella.  Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room.  Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programmes.st: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy.  Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey.  Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business.  The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs.  Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job.  His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird.  He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract.  The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.
Howard Morris guest stars as Ernest T. Bass as the Darling clan returns to Mayberry with its own kind of mountain trouble.
Andy tries to counsel the constantly bickering couple, Fred and Jennie Boone, with mixed results.
A poor farmer successfully auditions to sing at a concert. Barney and Andy take it upon themselves to spruce him up for the event.
Andy teaches a wealthy young man the satisfaction of self-reliance.
An old penniless citizen of Mayberry forestalls his eviction by trying to redeem a century-old municipal bond.
Andy is put on trial for his law enforcement practices when a Raleigh newspaper reporter writes a damaging article about the lawman.
Opie seems in line for a new bicycle as he comes home with an all A report card.
Deputy Barney Fife helps Opie with his schoolwork, using a teaching method all his own.
Joyce Jameson and Jean Carson appear as two fun-loving blondes who upset the sheriff's office.
Aunt Bee becomes warden for a day when she disciplines Otis Campbell after he is arrested for his usual drunken behavior.
The new mayor in town is displeased with Andy's laid-back small-town approach to law enforcement.
Barney Fife is sure that a Main Street gun duel is in the offing when an ex-con comes to town.
A bogus FBI agent and his accomplice nearly make off with the Mayberry Bank money.
Andy's girlfriend Peggy McMillan gets along fine with Andy until he discovers that her father is rich.

programmes.st: Andy and Helen Have Their Day
programmes.d: Andy and Helen are supposed to have a day off but are continually interrupted at their secluded picnic spot by Barney Fife asking questions about his duties.
Barney learns the hard way that three's a crowd when Andy and Mary Simpson try to find time alone together.
Opie's friendship with a hobo begins to affect his ability to tell right from wrong.
British comedian Bernard Fox plays an Englishman who returns to Mayberry and upsets Aunt Bee with his efficiency.
Barney interprets a kiss as a sign of a secret engagement between Andy and Helen. The town gets the word and prepares a surprise party for the couple.
Gomer falls asleep on the job and Andy douses a fire to save his life. Gomer becomes a menace trying to repay the favor.
Andy and Ellie stage a hold-up at the drugstore so that Barney can impress Miss Rosemary with his heroics.
Opie Taylor develops a crush on his teacher, who also happens to be his father's girlfriend.
Through a series of coincidences, Barney captures a dangerous criminal--twice.
Andy fears Opie has an imaginary friend when he starts telling tall tales.
Mayberry fears disaster when the sheriff discovers that a farmer's goat has eaten a good-sized meal of dynamite.
Andy uses his wits to help a struggling salesman stay in Mayberry despite strong pressure from the competition.
A car containing a high-powered businessman breaks down in low-powered Mayberry.
Barney Fife buys a bloodhound to aid in Mayberry law enforcement.
Andy gives the state troopers a lesson in the efficiency of a county sheriff when a dangerous criminal escapes.
Barney Fife is convinced that Opie's piggy bank is safer than the Mayberry bank-and sets out to prove his point.
Opie meets a spoiled youngster and decides his own allowance should be tripled.
Barney runs for sheriff when Andy seems lined up for another job. Andy's job falls through and he becomes a write-in candidate for re-election.
Opie learns a lesson in friendship when he befriends a newcomer to Mayberry.
