Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.
Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.
Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.
A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.
Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.
Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.
The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. Onboard is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.
At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.
Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.
While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.
Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.
Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.
Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.
Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.
The lazy Jackman brother's mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.
Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.
Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.
Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.
When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.
The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.
Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.
A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.
A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.
A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.
When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight.
An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork. Spotting the McCain ranch, he tells McCain he wants to buy it.
Young Dan Willard takes on Marshal Micah Torrence's job. With no experience, he takes a tough stand with a bunch of Texas cowhands whose high spirits are evident at the saloon.
Lucas and Mark are returning from a big cattle sale when the stage is robbed by three outlaws. Lucas, desperate to recover the money that was stolen, is determined to pursue the outlaws.
Lucas gets in trouble when he accuses the foreman of a neighboring ranch of rustling some of his cattle.
An Argentine family moves to North Fork. The townspeople are unfriendly to them, making fun of their clothing and customs. The Argentinean adult immigrant is openly hostile in return.
Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax after they adopt a stray horse whose owner has been killed in a gunfight.
After the end of the Civil War, General Phil Sheridan, who has been appointed Governor of the New Mexico Territory, is on an inspection tour of the country.
A famous gunfighter marries and decides to retire. He and his wife settle down in North Fork and open a store, but three outlaws arrive in town looking to best him in a gunfight.
A toy telephone becomes the link between a young boy and his dead grandmother.
A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programmes.st: The Last Night of a Jockey
programmes.d: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.

Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he "wins" against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.
A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.
An astronaut arrives back on Earth, then notices things have changed in his absence.
Vollmer, a small-time neo-Nazi, takes advice from a shadowy benefactor on how to increase his followers.
Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.
A 12-year-old girl who lost her parents in a fire doesn't speak because she has grown up in a secret telepathic community.
A man considers several possibilities when offered one wish by a genie.
A reporter finds himself trapped in a small town where the people have extraordinary powers.
Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...
An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.
A three-man spacecraft lands on a planet only to discover the wreckage of a spacecraft identical to their own.
Jess-Belle enlists the aid of a local witch who casts a spell that makes Billy-Ben fall in love with her.
Before he died, notorious gunslinger Pinto Sykes put a curse on hired-gun Conny Miller. Miller returns to town and is challenged to visit the grave of Sykes, despite the curse.
With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.
Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.
A man is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.
A scientist creates an android that has the qualities which he feels he's lacking.
In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Grand Emir
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon, assigned to protect a Middle Eastern despot from assassination, find their task complicated by the attitude of the degenerate tyrant, Emir El Emid.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Whirring Death
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon help Governor Lewis keep the state of California solvent by seeing that a pledged $5,000,000 from each of three wealthy but disreputable personsis turned over to the governor.
Two U.S. Supreme Court Justices have died mysteriously but Justice Chaynedis misses secret agent James T. West's concern for his life.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Bars Of Hell
programmes.d: Secret agent James T. West poses as a Federal prison inspector and his side-kick, Artemus Gordon, pretends he is a preacher when the two are assigned to halt an organized outbreak of terror that has paralyzed a western community.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Two-Legged Buffalo
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon are assigned to protect South Seas island prince who insists on going to an exclusive health resort where assassins are waiting to kill him.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Druid's Blood
programmes.d: Secret agent James T. West, probing the murder by fire of one of his former professors, Dr. Robey, a distinguished archaeologist, is ordered off the case at the request of U.S. Senator Hungerford.
Posing as a notorious hired gunman and a corrupt colonel, secret agents James T.West and Artemus Gordon infiltrate the forces of renegade-army leader Thorald Wolfe.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Burning Diamond
programmes.d: Secret agent James T. West is asking the Serbian minister to place his country's fabulous Kara diamond in federal custody until the International Jewel Exhibit opens, when suddenly the gem's case explodes and the jewel disappears.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Murderous Spring
programmes.d: A tall, powerfully built girl, Kitten Twitty, registers at a hotel and secret agent James T. West carries her trunk to her room, not knowing it contains his archenemy—diminutive, giggling Dr. Loveless.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Sudden Plague
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon find the town of Willow Springs looted and its citizens completely immobile -- victims of a mysterious paralysis.
Secret agent, James T. West, investigating the murder of a fellow agent, discovers a plot to assassinate the President of Mexico.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Golden Cobra
programmes.d: A self-styled maharajah kidnaps secret agent James T. West and holds him captive in his palace.
Agents West and Gordon again face Dr. Loveless whom, planning to rule a world of "little people," reduces West to a six-inch miniature.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Big Blast
programmes.d: A mad woman scientist creates a bomb-carrying robot identical to agent Westand orders it to kill members of the President's cabinet.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Returning Dead
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon employ the services of a man who possesses a power of concentration that controls animals.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Flying Pie Plate
programmes.d: Agent West gets involved in a bizarre extortion scheme involving green "Venusians" who claim they need gold for spaceship fuel.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Poisonous Posey
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon visit a town named Justice during Law and Order Seek and find it the site for a convention of criminals.
Loggers unearth deadly insect-like creatures that cocoon their victims.
Mulder and Scully pursue the Flukeman, a mutant in the NJ sewer system.
The agents investigate a legendary lake creature named Big Blue.
The agents investigate when several people disappear in a remote region of Florida.
Mulder and Scully search for a sea monster.
A mystery involving two skeletons leads the agents on a puzzling journey.
A monster starving for human brains tries to remedy his eating habits.
Mulder and Scully search for a humanoid killer with a savage murder spree.
Mulder and Scully are followed documentary-style by a Cops camera crew.
Scientists at a remote Alaskan outpost are killed by an alien parasite.
Two men are believed to have been killed by a powerful psychokinetic force.
The psychic predictions of a death row inmate help apprehend a murderer.
Mulder and Scully investigate the exorcism of a boy possessed by evil.
Mulder meets a woman in a cult whom he may have known in a previous life.
Ghostly images of female victims start to appear near murder scenes.
Mulder and Scully investigate a haunted house on Christmas Eve.
The Millennium Group attempts to attain an Armageddon New Year.
Jack finds himself in hot water when best friends Larry's girl says she still has a mad crush on him.
Jack has two dates, so he talks Larry into posing as him and spending the day with his unwanted date, Janet's childhood friend, who is visiting from out of town.

Jack and Janet find a new roommate after Cindy moves off to dormitory life at nearby UCLA. She's Terri Alden, an emergency room nurse who starts off on the wrong foot with Jack in this sixth-season opener.
Larry has made his choice for a new roommate and Jack and Larry begin devising a plan to get rid of Terri.
Ralph Furley tries to impress his childhood rival by introducing Chrissy as his new bride.
Jack lies to his girlfriend in order to keep a date with his new romantic interest.
When Chrissy can't pay her share of the rent, she's helped by her cute, clever but catastrophically clumsy cousin, Cindy. Guest Star(s): Karen Austin
Jack poses as his own twin to romance Ralph Furley's attractive visiting niece.
Jack tries to subdue a drunk at the Regal Beagle, but it's Terri who takes care of the masher with her karate skills.

A surprise visit by the battling Ropers turns into a romantic triangle when lusty Helen seeks solace from Jack and Janet and lands in the arms of Ralph Furley. Guest Star(s): Norman Fell and Audra Lindley
Using Janet and Chrissy as allies, Jack pretends he lives alone when he falls for a girl he thinks is "old-fashioned."
The girls flip over a handsome Englishman who moves in next door, but Jack and Furley become convinced that he is one of London's most sought after criminals.
Janet loses her cool when the groovy guy and campus Adonis of her high school shows up for a date, and Jack and Chrissy conspire to leave them alone in the apartment.

Jack hosts a Sunday brunch to convince the Reverend Gilmore that the Bistro is a respectable establishment. He succeeds until the newlywed couple at the next table begin their honeymoon. Guest Star(s): Earl Boen
Furley helps Jack lose his "I can stay away for a week" bet with the girls.

Jack's father visits unexpectedly and resumes his good nature meddling. Jack explodes and tells him to stay out of his life, but when he learns his father has lost his job, Jack gives him the opportunity to be useful.
Chrissy accidentally eats the pie that Jack was entering in a statewide baking competition and then tries to substitute a ringer from the bakery.
Jack becomes entangled in a feud between his two roommates when Janet accuses Chrissy of stealing a handsome young executive from her.
Larry completely trusts Jack to show his teenage sister around town - until he discovers that they are still out at 2 a.m.
Jack and Chrissy hatch an outrageous scheme to transform sensible Janet into a high-powered bombshell in order to cool off the amorous advances of Larry.

Jack thinks Vicky wants a job in Houston and encourages her, causing her to think he wants to end their relationship. She interrupts Janet's wedding to find out why. They make up and the ceremony resumes. Jack proposes and is stunned by Vicky's refusal.

Vicky explains that she is afraid of marriage and suggests to Jack that they live together. Jack reluctantly agrees. They are toasting their first night together in their new apartment when they are interrupted by Mr. Bradford.
Janet fumes when she inadvertently fixes up Terri with a guy she wanted to date herself.
Jack gets caught in an exasperating willpower contest with Chrissy to determine whether he can give up women for longer than she can give up food.
When the roommates meet their new landlord they discover they have accidentally sold all his furniture, thinking it was the Ropers!
Jack believes Chrissy's friend is the perfect sweetie to bring home to mom, until Janet discovers she's a high-priced call girl headed for a wild convention.
Jack and Chrissy offer to baby-sit for Stanley Roper's parakeet in exchange for a couple of concert tickets.
Jack and Janet are shocked as evidence mounts that Chrissy seems compelled to steal, not only from them but also from the Ropers.

An unexpected visit from Chrissy's father, the minister, throws the kids into a panic. Jack decides to move out temporarily but Reverend Snow arrives before Jack can leave. Fumbling for an explanation, Janet blurts out that she and Jack are married.
Jack has guilt feelings about not standing up to the tough guy who makes a play for Chrissy at the local pub and goes back the next night to tell the Casanova off.

Jack meets an old flame at the park who is seeking advice about her jealous husband. Furley joins them, and they all get poison oak. Later, at Jack's house, Furley tells the husband they were all in the bushes together.
Chrissy falls for an older man she meets at the supermarket. Jack is jealous, but he's even more upset when Mr. Roper tells Jack and Janet that she knows the man's wife. Guest Star(s): Dick Sargeant
Jack and Terri believe that Janet is trying to seduce Furley's shy nephew.

programmes.t: Erik Morales vs Marco Antonio Barrera
programmes.d: On February 19th, 2000 Erik Morales fought Marco Antonio Barrera for WBC and WBO World Super Bantamweight titles at Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas which ended in a split decision victory for Morales.

programmes.t: Erik Morales vs Marco Antonio Barrera II
programmes.d: On June 22nd, 2002 Erik Morales faced Marco Antonio Barrera for a second time at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas for the WBC world featherweight title in a bout that went 12 rounds ending in a victory for Barrera.

programmes.t: Erik Morales vs Marco Antonio Barrera III
programmes.d: On November 27th, 2004 Erik Morales and Marco Antonio Barrera faced eachother for the third and final time at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas in a bout that went 12 rounds ending in a victory for Barrera.

On April 19th, 1991, Evander Holyfield fought George Foreman for the WBC, WBA, and IBF Heavyweight Titles in Atlantic City. Both fighters displayed incredible skill and resilience, but Holyfield ultimately emerged victorious after 12 rounds.

On June 19th, 1992 Evander Holyfield battles Larry Holmes for the IBF, WBA, and WBC World Heavyweight title they battled at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas the bout went a full twelve rounds and ended in a unanimous decision win for Holyfield.

programmes.t: Felix Trinidad vs Oscar De La Hoya
programmes.d: On September 18th, 1999 Felix Trinidad and Oscar De La Hoya faced eachother for the IBF and WBC World welterweight title at the Mandalay Bay Resort in Las Vegas that ended in a majority decision win for Trinidad.

programmes.t: Floyd Mayweather vs Jose Luis Castillo 1
programmes.d: On April 20th, 2002 Floyd Mayweather fought Jose Luis Castillo for the first time at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas for WBC World lightweight titles in a bout that went 12 rounds ending in a victory for Mayweather.

programmes.t: Floyd Mayeather vs Jose Luis Castillo 2
programmes.d: On December 7th, 2002 Floyd Mayweather faced Jose Luis Castillo for a second time at Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino in Las Vegas for WBC World lightweight titles resulting in a unamimous decision win for Mayweather.

programmes.t: Floyd Mayweather Jr vs Justin Juuko
programmes.d: On May 22nd, 1999 Floyd Mayweather fought Justin Juuko at the Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino in Las Vegas for the WBC World Super featherweight title with the bout ending in round nine resulting in a victory for Mayweather

On June 25th, 2005 Floyd Mayweather fought Arturo Gatti at the Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City for the WBC World Super Lightweight title with Gatti down in round 1 the fight ended in a victory for Mayweather.

programmes.t: Floyd Mayweather vs Carlos Alberto Ramon Rios
programmes.d: On February 17th, 1999, Floyd Mayweather fought Carlos Rios for the WBC Super Featherweight Title in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Rios was a tough opponent for Mayweather, but Mayweather prevailed and showed out in front of his hometown, winning by UD.

On May 22nd, 2004 Floyd Mayweather fought DeMarcus Corley at the Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City for the WBC World Light Welterweight Title eliminator with Corely going down in round 8 and round 10 resulting in a win for Mayweather.

On January 20th, 2001 Floyd Mayweather faced Diego Corrales in a battle for the WBC World super feather weight titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas ending in a technical knockout victory for Mayweather.

On January 9th, 1998, Floyd Mayweather fought Hector Arroyo in a featherweight bout in Biloxi, Mississippi. A young Mayweather hungry for a title shot came out quick against Arroyo, stopping him in the fifth round of the fight.

On June 14th, 1997, Floyd Mayweather fought Larry O'Shields in a lightweight bout at the Alamodome in San Antonio, Texas. A young Mayweather showed his impressive speed and agility, earning a unanimous decision victory.

On May 2nd, 2015, Floyd Mayweather fought Manny Pacquiao in what was labeled as the "Fight of the Century." Floyd Mayweather emerged victorious via a unanimous decision, showcasing his exceptional defensive skills against Pacquiao's aggressive style.

On November 1st, 2003 Floyd Mayweather and Phillip N'dou fought eachother for the WBC world lightweight title at the Van Andel Arena in Grand Rapids with Mayweather ending the bout early for a technical knockout victory

On April 8th, 2006, Floyd Mayweather fought Zab Judah for the IBF and IBO Welterweight Titles at Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas. In a fight with a dramatic melee in round 10, Mayweather cruised in the later rounds to win by unanimous decision.

Danny and the guys attempt to complete a 1961 Cadillac Coup de Ville in order to get not one, but two Counts Kustoms cars into the world's biggest auto trade show; Danny comes face to face with something from his past.
Danny discovers the rarest Cadillac collection he's ever seen; Horny Mike has 30 days to move his bus from the shop's parking lot.

Danny has big plans for a little street rocket known as a Manta; the crew commissions a 1980s Corvette that the owner wants to bring into the new millennium; Shannon meets a lady motorcycle racer who wants her Harley XR1200 customized.

Rock legend Alice Cooper brings his prized '63 Studebaker Avanti to the shop; the crew restores Truckee California FD's historic 1937 fire truck; Ryan adds world-class tattoo-themed graphics to a limited edition 2019 Harley-Davidson CVO motorcycle.
Music industry royalty, Del Bryant has a Blazer with which he wants to pay tribute to his Tennessee roots, while Mike and Ryan check out a very rare 1963 Oldsmobile they think the Count has to own.

When Principal Eikner leaves Hollywood Arts, the school hires a new principal who makes all the students re-audition in order to keep their spots. Who will get kicked out?

The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.
Andre spends time with Jade working on a song and develops a crush on her. Tori tries to help him get over his crush, but nothing seems to work, and Andre has trouble keeping his feelings a secret.

programmes.d: The Mistress of the Dark hosts a special episode of Mistress-Piece Theater to give this confounding 1966 B-movie marvel the full thespian treatment.

Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

Marine researchers discover a colossal shark tooth off the Mexican coast and realize the most menacing beast that ever ruled the ocean is still alive.

A novelist warped by serial-killer research must confront his spiraling paranoia when a film executive expresses interest in adapting his screenplay.
Passengers and crew on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces that might be more or less deadly than one of their fellow travelers.

programmes.t: Maniac Cop III: Badge of Silence
programmes.d: A young female cop is framed for murder. She falls in love with the Maniac Cop, who seeks out justice for her, no matter the cost.
Rescued from a shipwreck, a couple soon falls prey to a deranged doctor who wants to use them as incubators for a giant spider's eggs.
A giant crocodile hunts for its stolen eggs, devouring anyone in its path, including a rowdy group of spring breakers whose party is cut short.
Factory worker Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newborn mutant baby.
Years before Father Lankester Merrin exorcized Pazuzu from Regan MacNeil's soul, he first encounters the King of the Evil Wind Demons in East Africa.
A popular horror novelist heads to spooky Appalachia in search of inspiration, and becomes the prime suspect in a missing person case.
A woman who begins investigating the deaths of victims who suffered from sleep paralysis soon finds she must save herself from an ancient evil.
When a solitary and strange adolescent boy makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of the forest, he wreaks vengeance on those who harass him.
Forced by desperate circumstances, two sisters rob a bank and are given instructions to check an old vault, where something dark resides.
A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.
A psychic and a team of TV ghost hunters travel to New Orleans to investigate a haunted house rumored to be the site of paranormal activity.

programmes.t: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket of Blood
programmes.d: The Mistress of the Dark presents this 1959 Roger Corman flick about a busboy’s bloody brush with sculpture while trying her own hand at the arts.

Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

The Big Game returns to Las Vegas for its third season, with a new Loose Cannon stepping into the spotlight. Plus, MMA fighter 'Suga' Sean O'Malley makes his explosive high stakes debut. Can the amateurs hold their own against top poker pros?

programmes.t: The Pokerstars Big Game on Tour - Episode 3
programmes.d: In Vegas, Matt Berkey and Jason Koon dominate the game. The Loose Cannon and Sean O'Malley face challenges. One player exits, opening a seat.

More high stakes action from Las Vegas. Loose Cannon Andy Taylor is on the comeback trail, hitting some hands and making bold bluffs. 'Suga' Sean O'Malley is sent spiraling. And Shaun Deeb builds momentum, becoming an even bigger threat at the table.

Decision time for Loose Cannon Andy Taylor: lock up a small profit, or put it all on the line? As this cash game nears its end, 'Suga' Sean is determined to get out of the hole, while Jason Koon and Matt Berkey compete to be the biggest winner.

Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

Monty travels across the south west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.
Monty helps two families create dream gardens that are as much for the children as for the adults. In Doncaster, Nikki and John want a garden full of edible plants and fruit.

Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

Monty's in the jewel garden showing which plants need protection from the elements now and which ones can be left until after the first frosts. He also plants out berried shrubs to help feed wildlife in the winter, harvests pumpkins and shows how to make use of fallen autumnal leaves.

The vegetable garden is at its peak now and as well as harvesting, Monty takes a look at how his autumn crops are faring as well as giving tips on how to keep the garden looking at its best. Adam Frost returns to Leicester where he has been helping to create a garden from scratch on a new build estate, and Frances Tophill celebrates the summer harvest on her shared allotment.

Monty Don harvests apples, pears and quince and plants indoor bulbs, we meet a Northern Irish daffodil breeder, and Carol Klein travels to Wales to explore the Eupatorium with a passionate gardener who has a rare and spectacular collection.
Monty Don tackles autumn lawn maintenance tasks, Carol Klein is looking at burnets, and we meet a man who's dedicated himself to a North American prairie favourite, the echinacea.

Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.
Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.
Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.
Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

At Longmeadow, Monty plants out his tomatoes, continues work in his paradise garden, and reveals plans for a new project. In Peterborough, a city garden with a lack of space has not proved a problem for a couple who have created a woodland garden.

With autumn just around the corner, Adam takes stock of his garden and plans ahead for some late-season interest under the supervision of Ash the cat. Plus, Frances visits a garden in Kent where the plants provide a non-stop buffet for insects.

Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

At Longmeadow, Monty is planning for next summer by sowing a batch of sweet peas. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is amongst the leaves, bark and berries at Thorp Perrow Arboretum in Yorkshire admiring the onset of the autumn display. Plus, there's a visit to Ryton Gardens in Warwickshire to find out about their collection of heritage vegetables and how to collect their seeds.

In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. Joe Swift meets fashion icon, Dame Zandra Rhodes, to explore how the flowers she likes to grow have influenced her designs over the years.

After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.
Monty Don prepares for his spring display and tackles slippery paths, Carol Klein visits a collection of Michaelmas daisies and we visit a veg grower with a show-stopping Halloween pumpkin.

Adam Frost shares the progress that's been made in his garden. Frances Tophill heads to the beach to reveal what gardeners can learn from the coastal plants which have evolved to cope with more extreme conditions.
Monty Don tackles some seasonal gardening jobs at Longmeadow and guest presenter Matthew Wilson has some ideas to brighten up a dark, north-facing wall.

Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

Monty propagates succulent plants, revisits his container vegetable garden, and gives advice on how to get a good crop of pumpkins. Adam looks a new garden at RHS Hyde Hall in Essex, and Rachel visits a garden of vibrant colours in Wiltshire.

This time there's plenty to do to prepare for the season to come and Monty Don is clearing out spent crops and mulching his asparagus. Joe Swift's been to visit keen gardeners, Wayne and Geraldine Hemingway, to see how they combine sustainability with their designer-style. Carol Klein's exploring the history of the rose at Coughton Court, one of our best rose gardens and Monty plants a new rose of his own. What happens when you have to downsize and leave your much-loved garden?

Monty shows how to take cuttings from herbs, prune summer raspberries and plant daylilies. Meanwhile, Adam travels to Whitstable on the Kent coast to see how gardeners cope with the wild, wet and windy weather.
Monty Don tackles autumn lawn maintenance tasks, Carol Klein is looking at burnets, and we meet a man who's dedicated himself to a North American prairie favourite, the echinacea.

At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.
Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

At Longmeadow Monty checks the progress of the potatoes he planted earlier in the year and recommends plants for dry shade under trees.We travel to Somerset to get water saving tips from a water scientist who uses a variety of techniques to save as much water as possible in her own garden and we meet a gardener who has filled his home with over one thousand houseplants.

Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

Monty and the team are at RHS Rosemoor in Devon to find out about their fruit trees and sedum collection, and Joe visits Scampston Hall, home of a ten-year experiment in naturalistic planting by garden designer Piet Oudolf.
Monty undertakes more seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Arit Anderson meets a garden designer in Somerset who has worked in harmony with nature to create a garden on a former brownfield site.

Monty Don tackles the perennial problem of what to grow in the shade beneath a tree, Carol Klein takes a look at the crocosmia and we meet a gardener in Derbyshire who has spent a lifetime growing and showing gladioli.
Monty gives more advice on tomato-growing, Nick Bailey travels to South Africa in search of the cousins of the Crocosmia, and Advolly Richmond looks at the Victorian trend of garden theme parks.

Monty propagates succulent plants, revisits his container vegetable garden, and gives advice on how to get a good crop of pumpkins. Adam looks a new garden at RHS Hyde Hall in Essex, and Rachel visits a garden of vibrant colours in Wiltshire.

Adam Frost is in his garden, catching viewers up on his new patio project and discussing his plans for the autumn. Arit Anderson travels to Somerset to meet landscape designer Dan Pearson, to find out about the design and planting principles he has used to create his own garden.

A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home.  The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed.  Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child.  Both had been murdered.  Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car.  The hair was too small for analysis.

In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation.  With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators.  On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies.  They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car.  What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator.  Europe was dealing with a serial killer.  With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. On August 20, 1980, an unseen sniper murdered two young black men as they jogged with two white women in Salt Lake City, Utah.  Police threw all their resources into finding a killer who left almost no clues behind.  They met with FBI agents and detectives from around the country who had similar racially motivated sniper slayings.  A month later, working off little more than a possible license plate number, police in Kentucky arrested Joseph Paul Franklin but the man escaped from custody.

By April of 1995 in Washington, D.C., two officers had been shot and one had been murdered. Each had been sitting in their patrol cars when a man sneaked up and opened fire. The FBI was brought in to help catch the cop killer.  Agents identified the man who was most likely the killer, but he was nowhere to be found.  Months of surveillance operations around the country finally yielded a break; they found their suspect in Baltimore, MD.

Racial tensions in Buffalo in 1980 were at an all-time high.  Six black males had been brutally murdered--two had their hearts cut out.  The only thing connecting the victims was their ethnicity and the fact that each had been shot with .22 caliber bullets. Residents screamed for the police to stop this serial killer.  With no suspects, local investigators turned to the FBI.  Profilers were able to produce a psychological composite of the type of person the killer would most likely be.  Their an

On February 3, 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her mother's home and disappeared without a trace.  Her mother hoped Pasadena, Texas police could find her before it was too late.  Six months later, their worst fear was realized when a farmer discovered the young girl's remains in an Illinois barn.  The FBI was called in to help.  Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for 50 more deaths.  Investigators knew they had to stop this menace of the highways.

When a Delaware woman vanished in 1996, family and friends discovered her secret life.  The appointments secretary to the Governor had carried on an illicit affair with a wealthy married man.  Agents suspected that her powerful ex-lover was responsible, but they had little physical evidence to support their theory.  Investigators never found the woman's body or the murder weapon.  The FBI's only hope was to go undercover, and turn brother against brother.

In the early 90s, Washington, D.C. police were losing the battle against street gangs who enforced their territories with lethal violence.  The homicide rate in the nation's capital climbed to the highest in the country.  Local police turned to the FBI for help, but agents soon found themselves in the direct line of fire.  In the fall of 1994, a gang member walked into police headquarters, killed two FBI agents and one detective, then turned the gun on himself.

In June of 1992, masked bandits pulled off a daring mid-day bank robbery.  It marked the beginning of a four-year crime wave that rocked Seattle.  With each new robbery, the bandits perfected their craft, leaving behind no evidence and escaping with hundreds and thousands of dollars.  As the robbers became increasingly violent, pressure mounted to end their reign.  With few leads, the FBI forced their own luck.  The effort put them face to face with an armed and desperate fugitive.

When police in a small Washington State community began looking into the disappearance of a 22-year-old woman, they had no way of knowing it would evolve into a nationwide hunt for a sexual sadist.  Police knew the killer's identity, but he was a master of disguise.  The FBI was called on to help.  Agents discovered that several unsuspecting women across the northwest had fallen prey to his charms.

A stranger snatched an eight-year-old girl as she played in her Tucson, Arizona neighborhood, leaving behind an abandoned bicycle and a frantic mother.  Hundreds of citizens and police officers fanned out across the region, hoping to find some trace of the young girl or her abductor.  Within hours, a suspect emerged; a drifter who was out on parole for abducting and molesting children.  He was nowhere to be found and time had run out for the innocent child.

On a chilly afternoon in 1989, Marine Captain Shirley Russell disappeared from Quantico, Virginia.  Captain Russell was a dedicated officer; her friends and colleagues were certain she had not gone AWOL.  FBI agents found her husband, a former Marine, was acting strangely, and a blood-like stain on the couple's floor disappeared before agents could examine it.  There was no body, no witness and no weapon.

In February of 1996, New Jersey millionaire Frank Black flew to Florida to close a major business deal before retiring.  He never came home.  Authorities in New Jersey sensed foul play and brought in the FBI.  Agents learned of a mystery woman in Florida who was to meet Black.  Phone records showed a flood of calls to Black from his business rival just before the disappearance.

In 1997, FBI agents began investigating New York gas station mogul Gurmeet Dhinsa for gas pump rigging.  They soon realized that Dhinsa was more than a crooked businessman, he enforced his mob-like operation with brutal violence, kidnapping and killing errant employees and any family members who questioned their deaths.  FBI agents worked their way into Dhinsa's violent world.

In the early 1980s, the decapitation of a young African-American male led the Miami-Dade police department and the FBI along a trail of murder.  Investigators quickly discovered that the victim was a dissident member of a religious sect headed by a man calling himself Yahweh ben Yahweh, or God, Son of God.  Although the FBI believed Yahweh ben Yahweh and his followers were responsible for many murders, they could find no direct evidence linking them to the crimes.

In November of 1994, when a Wells Fargo armored van disappeared from a Glendale, Arizona mall, local authorities and the FBI scrambled to recover it, and its cargo of nearly a million dollars. Six hours later, agents found the van, its driver shot dead inside and the money gone. It was a perfect hit by professionals who left no clue behind. Months passed before a solid lead developed. In January, a tip led agents to look into a former prison guard.

Beginning in California in 1995, a serial killer targeted vulnerable women. At first charming and generous, he quickly became violent. He was brutal with his kills and quick in his getaways. Traveling across the country, he struck in Mississippi, Louisiana and Florida. The FBI and local police needed to stop this cross-country killer before more women fell victim to his insatiable rage.

In 1987, a successful television producer was gunned down in his New York office.  It looked like a professional hit.  With no leads, the investigation stalled.  Four years later and a continent away, a man told Los Angeles police he had been hired to murder two exotic dancers.  Investigators linked the two crimes and uncovered a businessman willing to kill to protect his interests.

A 1981 armored car robbery near New York City left one guard dead and another critically wounded.  Police stopped suspects nearby and another shoot-out ensued, claiming the lives of two officers.  Local police and the FBI suspected a large group of domestic terrorists with a history of violent crime.  They would try to ferret out these heavily armed criminals who moved in a shadowy underworld and were not afraid to kill authorities.

When a California man was found dismembered in 1990, police suspected a local burglar, but they couldn't find him.  Six months later, he was caught robbing an Arizona bank and sentenced to life.  But prison couldn't hold him for long, and within a year he escaped.  The FBI would lead a multi-agency manhunt for a killer on a desperate run through the tourist regions of the west.

At first it seemed like a tragic hunting accident when 18-year-old David Wilkey was shot to death in rural Virginia in 1983.  A tenacious insurance investigator suspected foul play, but he had no direct evidence. Two years later a man contacted North Carolina FBI agents with a complex story of conspiracy and murder-for-hire: he claimed he had been hired to murder Wilkey's killer.

On a summer night in 1990, a body was discovered burning in a Minnesota alley.  Weeks later, police finally identified the victim, a suspected drug courier from California.  The FBI began working with local police and slowly uncovered a multi-state crime ring run by a deadly drug lord who used violence and intimidation to keep those around him silent.  Agents needed to infiltrate and dismantle the crew before more people died.

In the early 1990's drug gangs terrorized Harlem, New York neighborhoods. When a 10-year-old boy fell victim in the crossfire, NYPD detectives and FBI agents clamped down on the problem. They formed a task force called C-11, designed to dismantle the gangs. In an environment of violence and fear it would be difficult to identify, arrest and convict those involved in the secretive and deadly world of big money drugs.

In 1994, a teenage immigrant came to the United States to realize her dream of becoming a doctor.  But a tragic twist of fate intervened, when she found herself an innocent victim of the drug trade.  Kidnapped and held captive, she survived for days against all odds.  Authorities arrested her captors, but they refused to reveal her whereabouts. The FBI and local police raced against time, determined to save the teenager's life. Their investigation revealed a complex story of drugs, betrayal and

In the mid-1990's, a gang of professional bank robbers raided cities across seven states. Disguises and speed protected their identity from cameras and the police as they stole hundreds of thousands of dollars, always leaving a bomb to terrorize their victims. The stakes were raised when the FBI discovered the robbers had an agenda beyond their personal wealth. To stop these extremists and their growing operation, the FBI needed to capture their leaders.

A Labor Day weekend turned into a nightmare of murder as a cross-country crime spree terrorized the nation.  In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenage boy disappeared within hours of each other.  Police believed the cases were linked, but didn't know how. They contacted the FBI for help.  A trail of stolen vehicles and murder victims across seven states led agents on a hunt for two suspected killers. Their only hope of stopping them was to anticipate the killers' next move.

A day that began with a class field trip ended with a parent's worst nightmare.  An 11-year-old girl was missing.  Her parents were certain she was no runaway.  When they failed to find her in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.  The FBI soon joined the investigation and family and friends worked with detectives and agents in an urgent search for the missing girl.  Faced with conflicting witness reports and false leads, agents wouldn't stop until they found the girl, and t

In the summer of 1988, a wealthy Jackson, Mississippi woman disappeared from her home in broad daylight.  Left behind was a mysterious ransom note listing twelve names and no specific instructions.  The note, and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate. FBI and local police struggled to find answers in the cryptic message so they could find the kidnapper and retrieve the victim before her time ran out. Solving the crime required the keen insight of a criminal profiler and the persev

In Arizona, a shipment of money vanished into the high desert, along with the two men hired to guard it.  The FBI didn't know if the guards were participants or victims of an ambush.  Answers lay somewhere in the thousands of square miles of Arizona's northwest territory.  When the vehicle was recovered with three hundred thousand dollars and the drivers missing, suspicions that the crime was an inside job grew.

In Alabama, a pair of convicted felons escaped the custody of a local deputy and fled across the country.  Eluding authorities, they moved from state to state in a wave of abduction and car theft.  When a foreign military officer disappeared along their trail, police and FBI agents wondered if the armed fugitives had become killers.  Agents believed the pair were growing more violent and raced to find the escapees before more victims crossed their path.

In 1992, a young mother was gunned down in front of her children.  Police searched for answers, but found none. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless, and random. Then, family members offered a startling clue.  The victim, the wife of a prominent Atlanta attorney, was also a woman burdened with a secret; a secret the FBI believed led to her death.  It would force local and federal agents to untangle an intricate web of money, drugs and murder.

In Memphis, Tennessee, a horrible crime terrified local residents.  When a wealthy young mother was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects.  The twenty-five year old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband, and several spurned boyfriends.  All were on the FBI's short list.  To find the woman and her abductor, investigators would have to first determine the motive.

In 1997, a series of crimes in a small Iowa farming community left residents reeling in shock and fear. Two young men went on a crime spree of robbery, kidnapping and murder, and then disappeared. By the time they were identified, they already had a twelve-hour lead. As the hunt for the two men expanded, the FBI committed its resources to tracking down the suspects. The pursuit would take agents across six states to catch the killers before they struck again.

In the late 80's, Florida's cocaine imports were among the highest in the nation.  Regional territories were enforced with intimidation and murder.  Desperate to stop the violence, local authorities turned to the FBI for help. One dealer bowed to no one.  He would stop at nothing to keep detectives and agents from building a case against him.  When his organization began targeting the government itself, a city went on high alert.

In Kokomo, Indiana an unthinkable crime terrified residents. A young woman was snatched from her home on a bright spring morning.  Drops of blood and a torn window screen were all that was left to tell authorities what happened to the twenty-one year old victim. After several days of searching, a former FBI profiler narrowed the suspect list to one. Agents and detectives followed the trail across state lines hoping to find the victim before her time ran out.

In July 1997, a triple murder terrified residents in the nation's capital. In a Georgetown coffee shop, three employees were shot to death. Investigators could find no immediate suspects and no clear motive for the attack. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong, or an act of cold-blooded vengeance against one of the victims?

In 1986, a small crime free Indiana town was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. After an officer was gunned down at point-blank range, the psychotic killer led investigators across the Midwest. No one knew where the gunman would strike next, even as his tally of murders and abductions grew. The FBI and state police raced against time to rescue America's heartland from this deranged gunman, before he killed again.

In Langley, Virginia, a gunman fired into rush hour traffic.  The brazen daytime shooting of employees from the Central Intelligence Agency stunned the country.  The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political. The FBI was called in, but the nationwide search quickly became a far-reaching international manhunt. Agents processed more than 2000 leads and crossed an ocean in the effort to deliver justice.

On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her 10 year-old son was missing from his school. No one knew how it could have happened.  Within hours, the boy's entire family was frantically searching for him. The few leads in the case quickly turned cold and the FBI was called in to aid in the investigation. The search by agents and local authorities would cover a thousand miles to expose the kidnapper and find the missing child.

It's contract negotiation time at Cobb's and after 12 years, Bannister feels he deserves a raise.

Cobb's is in the middle of 'Swiss Week' but Bannister has traveling plans of his own; he's to be interviewed for a job in Italy. But there's no mention of him taking Edna. Suddenly an alarm in the store goes off and changes all his plans.
Memories may be a beautiful thing but the staff at Cobb's find themselves wishing to forget some of their past mistakes for the 50th anniversary of Cobb's.
The city plans on removal of a stately old tree and Howard galvanized Cobbs employees to protest. Howard, Viker, Leslie, and Jake are thrown in jail and have to plead their case before a judge.
Marlene reverts to a stuttering timid child when her father returns for a visit. Bannister decides to give them both advice.

Christian is preparing for his first vacation in years. His plane leaves in an hour but he's lingering at the store. When he learns Edna will be taking over, he has a time of relief, until he learns that her first duty will be a conference in Tokyo. He panics as it's too late to cancel his trip.

Helen is convinced Stanley is having an affair when she sees him give a locket to another women.
Helen volunteers Stanley to babysit on his poker night.
Stanley fears Helen accidentally gave a box containing his girlie magazines to a church rummage sale.

Vicky and Jack try to spend time sharing each others' non-sexual interests.

Edna's mother is visiting on the same day Marlene is wearing a ring from some guy she doesn't know the name of. Edna tries on the ring and it gets stuck on her finger. Nothing will remove the ring, and the first thing her mother notices is the ring.

Howard receives a chain letter and declines to continue despite the urging of his superstitious co-workers. Then accidents start to occur at Cobbs and Marlene heads to the hospital. Howard starts to rethink his actions.
While Edna is on vacation Molly, a woman from Howard's past, shows up with a boy who she claims is Howard's son. While Bannister adjusts to the idea of being a dad he also bonds with the teen Mickey.
Edna has tickets for a ballet show, but Howard doesn't want to go. He then gets jealous when she takes someone else.

There isn't enough parking at Cobb's. Bannister finds himself parking in Christian's spot which leads to everyone starting to car-pool. Christian want's money from everyone for gas, but no one wants to pay. Bannister discovers Edna has been throwing out all of her parking tickets.

Birthday girl Edna receives flowers from one of her high school sweethearts who want to see her again. Their reunion gets interrupted when a jealous Bannister shows up and learns they were actually married.

Jack mistakenly believes that Vicky's friend is coming onto him.

Jack butts heads with James on a radio debate show.
When Jack and Vicky are cast in a commercial for her airline, Jack fights with the temperamental director.

A man shows up and claims to be Stanley's son. Stanley admits to know his mother, but doesn't remember the night that she claimed to conceive her son. Roper goes to talk to a friend who was with him at the time to find out if the claims are true.
Helen adores the Brookes' boy, David, which leads her to feel she and Stanley could adopt a baby. Stanley is against it. Still, she calls an agency and sets up a home interview.

Stanley's going to be in trouble if Helen finds out he's lost her new puppy "Muffin" on a walk. He decides that a look-alike just might fool her and get him off the hook. Will Stanley get away with it or be barked at by Helen?
The clock Stanley gives Helen for their anniversary turns out to be stolen from Brookes' apartment.
On the day that Helen is making dinner to impress her rich sister, Ethel, the utilities are cut off because Stanley forgot to pay the bills. He goes to great lengths to hide his mistake.

Both Stanley and Jeffrey argue with their wives and walk out on them at the same time. Getting drunk at a bar brings them together as buddies, but sobering up may open their eyes to a big problem they've unwittingly created.
A fire in the kitchen leads to the Ropers having to stay with the Brookes family until their place is ready again. However, Stanley's behavior gets on Jeffrey's last nerve.

Helen hires Stanley's friend, Joey, to haul out their furniture so she can redecorate. Her brother in law, Hubert, hears of Helen's plan and decides to buy some new furniture. Joey offers to sell his furniture for him and sells it to Stanley. When Helen sees he bought her sister's furniture she freaks out.

Emilia, contemplando la maternidad en un mundo pospandemico, forma una conexion inesperada con su deprimido vecino anciano, Felipe.

Three bumbling crooks try to rob a bank but end up stealing a priceless erotic statue. Now, they’re chased by a ruthless art collector, his hitmen, and their furious wives.
Embark on a thrilling journey with Bénédicte, an electrifying dancer, as she fearlessly remixes Papa Wemba's classic hit "Zero".
Grieving his brother's death, Church goes to an open mic with Ol' Skool. A poet's words spark his anger and suspicions, setting off lies and deception that lead to a life-changing confrontation.

In Colao 2, Antonio and Laura are now married with a daughter, but six years in, their love faces real-life trials. As Laura launches a bold new venture—“The Organic Coffee Route”—she hopes to reignite purpose and harmony in their countryside life.

Tim Coleman's search for love has been one hell of a ride, leaving him to question love after every failed attempt. Will Tim's intensified search for love be troubled even the more by a small town girl?
Follows characters navigating personal struggles like finding themselves, seeking revenge, and pursuing love and success in a wild business world.
Charlie, a COAD (Child of a Deaf Adult) embarks on an adventure to find her mom’s missing bracelet, uncovering stunning views and hidden treasures along the way.
After years in New York, Mercedes, a hardworking teacher, returns to the Dominican Republic and lands a job to teach modern dance in a high-class school - knowing nothing about modern dance.

Clem and Clara find themselves locked up in an unknown apartment. They are faced with either loving each other or hating each other. Is this a cruel experiment? When the truth finally emerges, will it bring them together or tear them apart forever?
Charleston White is scrambling to pay overdue rent while Dallas detectives close in with questions he’s not ready to answer.
A family in serious debt trouble finds themselves between an abusive creditor and a nephew with a large inheritance.

Aaron Davis is accused of murder for a crime he didn’t commit. His son Jalen gets entangled with dangerous drug dealers. Will Aaron find a way to prove his innocence and save his son’s life before it is too late?
When Maya catches her boyfriend in the act with another woman, her heartbreak turns to fury. Armed and demanding the truth, she holds them both at gunpoint until she gets the answers she craves.

A faithful woman believes God has led her to the husband she's always prayed for, but when secrets and betrayal threaten their marriage, she must discover whether her true strength lies in love—or in God's unshakable grace.
A hard-headed rural youth cycles over the unforgiving Kwazulu-Natal countryside to reach a career-making bicycle race. To succeed, he must learn to work with his family and community.
Charles tests the depth of his fiance's love by presenting her with a diamondless engagement ring, separating true love from materialism.
Three teenage boys from Atlanta set out on a transformative journey to climb four 12,000 foot snow-capped peaks in the heart of the Colorado wilderness.
Narcotics investigators in a rural West Tennessee county pursue a local kingpin who's dealing with mutiny within his own organization.
Successful dentist Kelly has everything but love as her sister’s engagement pushes her to finally face romance.
An aspiring sportscaster lucks into a superstars old number, unlocking VIP fame and fun until the real owner shows up.
In a family where daughters are unwanted by their own father, Nanjala carves her own path as a journalist in a country buried deep in corruption.
Basti goes on a quest to find the elusive marang to satisfy his pregnant wife’s cravings.
Basti tries his best to tolerate Iris as her mood swings worsen. Later, he throws a party to celebrate his wife’s pregnancy.

Basti throws a successful pregnancy party for Iris with their loved ones, who are all excited about the couple’s first child. Things take a turn for the worse when Iris discovers she is experiencing light bleeding.
Iris tries to return to her normal life after losing her and Basti’s unborn baby. Meanwhile, Valerie is left heartbroken when Nestor makes it clear that their relationship is over.
Basti and Cass throw a heartwarming surprise party for Iris to make her happy. Meanwhile, Valerie comes to Nestor’s rescue when the press learns of their company’s troubles.
Basti receives unexpected news about his entry in a wedding video contest. Meanwhile, Iris tries to land a big-time client in hopes of getting her big break.
Iris and Kelly try their luck at securing a bidding slot for Zia Gallagher's wedding. Meanwhile, Nestor closes a deal with a client.

Iris, Basti, and Ali work overtime as The Love Team competes with top event management companies for Zia's wedding. Meanwhile, Iris and Basti celebrate their first Christmas together as husband and wife.
A theater artist and producer in NYC, Liz Casasola shares her life as an artist.
Caroline Garcia, a Sydney-based performance artist, shares how she lives her dream by creating small art sculptures and inserting herself in films and music videos.

With a clear conscience, Gabriel gives his DNA sample. Things seem in his favor when Carlos and Rigor’s plan fails, but Carlos presses charges. Gabriel faces the authorities as a witness testifies, while Maila receives a mysterious letter.

Eager to help Gabriel, his friends search for witnesses to prove his innocence. Carlos gloats during a jail visit, sparking a clash with Gabriel. Bianca helps her boyfriend, while Gabriel suspects Rigor and Carlos’ connivance.

Lydia finally stands against Rigor and kicks him out of the house. With nowhere else to go, he turns to Carlos for help. Gabriel tries to prove his innocence, while an unexpected person discovers Carlos and Rigor’s secret connection.

Carlos shares his plan against Roman with Rigor. Gabriel tells the police about his suspicions regarding Carlos and Roman. Later, the police summon Carlos. Roman searches for Victoria’s missing phone, and Gabriel’s friends devise a plan to help him.
Gabriel uses his Tiger Shark knowledge in his thesis. Confident he will pass, Bianca gives him an early graduation gift. Roman questions Carlos, who rushes to find Victoria’s missing phone.

Gabriel proposes to Bianca. While loved ones celebrate, Lydia sneaks out to see Rigor but meets an unexpected person. Roman loses hope about Victoria’s killer, while Carlos stays determined to punish them.

Lydia confronts Rigor about his link to Carlos. Maila shares her assault suspicions with Gabriel. Maila and Bianca get good news about their witness, while Carlos orders Rigor to keep tabs on the key person in his mother’s puzzling death.

Maila tells Roman about Victoria’s possible role in her assault. Troubled, Roman confronts Rigor and orders someone to watch Carlos. Meanwhile, Gabriel finds Emilio and, with friends’ help, devises a new business idea.
When a zombie outbreak happens, two housemaids and a driver will need to survive their longest night ever as they get trapped inside the mansion.
Shirley is a caregiver and finds herself working for a strange family living in fear of her father.

Now that Leon is out of the picture, Robert vows to start his life anew with Romina. He becomes unstoppable in his plan to ruin Hector and begins to search for a solid evidence against the latter’s illegal transactions.

Things go south between Daniela and Robert when the Mondragon patriarch tries to shed light on the former's possible involvement in the botched plan against his life. Insulted, Daniela reminds his father of his deepest and darkest secret.

The brutal assault against Mikoy sends shockwaves through Marga’s world. This prompts her to visit her hapless friend. Daniela's decision to spy on Hector proves fruitful when she obtains a video footage of his argument with Alvin.
Romina commands Neil to distract Daniela while she tries to confirm her hunch once and for all. Soon, her efforts pay off when she obtains vital evidence against Hector and Alvin.
Roxanne agrees to help Romina arrest her father, Hector, after realizing the accusations against him may be true. Hector refuses to surrender and flees from authorities.
Romina remains troubled by Hector’s threat and seeks comfort from Robert. Meanwhile, Daniela works to hide her and Robert’s secret. Roxanne visits Hector in jail.
Leon prepares to start anew with Paco and Roxanne, leaving Cassie heartbroken. Meanwhile, Daniela reveals her trump card against Hector, forcing him to make a crucial decision.
Kulas confronts Romina over Jessa and their unborn child, prompting Robert to discover her withdrawn rape case against Carlos. Meanwhile, Cassie plans a romantic anniversary surprise.
Realizing when Andeng means to him, Anton decides to confess his feelings for her.
Anton refuses to give up in his pursuit of Andeng, despite the unexpected return on a rival.

When Chelsea Simms, the good-hearted brand strategist for the popular dating app The Nice List, discovers the app has granted her magical powers, she uses her newfound ability to make all of the �naughty� people in her life learn how to be good again. But when her plans go awry and Fisher, the kindly neighbor who has always carried a torch for Chelsea, is magically added to the naughty list by mistake, Chelsea must race against time to set things right before Christmas Eve.

A group of college students stay at school over Christmas to work at a special exhibit in the college's fine art gallery. When they decide to hold an unplanned Christmas Eve dinner in the gallery, they stumble into a trio of bumbling thugs planning a Holiday Heist of the exhibit. As the students are held hostage, they are forced to learn about themselves and each other.

Flower shop owner Poppy Benson enters the annual Holiday Floral Show for a chance to win the $5,000 grand prize. Standing in her way is Garrett Hurley, the underappreciated protege of florist extraordinaire Blair Covington. While Poppy and Garrett's rivalry heats up on the flower show floor, an undeniable romance begins amidst a whimsical holiday backdrop.

After accidentally destroying a bag of Christmas wishes, two junior elves learn that if even one wish goes unfulfilled, Christmas could be extinguished forever. For the first time in their lives, the elves Mindy and Cam venture out of the North Pole to collect the lost wishes. Along the way they enlist young Blake, whose family has a difficult time celebrating Christmas since his father died. With their deadline fast approaching, they have only one more wish to find…but whose could it be?

Jessica has a big presentation in Palm Springs. There are a couple of problems though: her two kids who will do anything to get mom and dad back together again - even if they have to hack mom's phone or pose as a secretary to make sure dad's in Palm Springs too. And father Joe who'll do anything to charm his way back into Jessica's life.

The holiday season is alive in New York, where a ballet rehearsal for The Nutcracker is underway. Carrie, the prima ballerina, focuses on guiding the young dancers around her. Meanwhile, Prince William is tasked with escorting Medea, a rising star ballerina, to New York. Medea's arrival disrupts the growing bond between Carrie and the Prince. When Medea is injured, the question arises: will Carrie step in to save the performance? Christmas magic may lead to more than just a show.

To save their struggling radio show, a young producer launches a live holiday segment setting up her recently separated boss on a series of blind dates. The ratings soar, and the buzz grows—but things get complicated when she unexpectedly falls for one of the charming contenders. As Christmas approaches, she must choose between her career ambitions and a shot at real love before the final date airs.

Life changes overnight for songwriting duo Brooke Remington and Chance Owens when NYC producer Rob Benson wants the demo Brooke submitted. But Rob wants Brooke solo. While dazzling her with dreams of stardom, Chance—secretly in love with Brooke—spirals. When Brooke discovers he once hid another big offer from her, she’s furious. Tensions rise until Chance fires her—only for Brooke to realize her heart’s with him, not the spotlight.

Struggling writer Annie Logan is devasted to learn that she won't be able to go home to the family tree farm in time for Christmas due to the demands of her high-powered boss. But when the tree farm is threatened with closure, Annie bids her life in New York goodbye and rushes home to save the place she has always called home.

When Veronika Daniels's co-host leaves "Rise and Shine," she opens auditions for replacements, including Charlie Fisher, a seasoned NY newscaster, and Emily Morgan, a spirited human interest reporter. Emily's unexpected viral plea for the job intensifies the competition. As they vie for the role leading up to the Christmas Day Telethon, old romantic feelings between Charlie and Emily resurface, adding a new layer of complexity to their professional rivalry.

The holiday season is alive in New York, where a ballet rehearsal for The Nutcracker is underway. Carrie, the prima ballerina, focuses on guiding the young dancers around her. Meanwhile, Prince William is tasked with escorting Medea, a rising star ballerina, to New York. Medea's arrival disrupts the growing bond between Carrie and the Prince. When Medea is injured, the question arises: will Carrie step in to save the performance? Christmas magic may lead to more than just a show.

Emily is determined to fulfil her father�s wishes to save the family dairy farm which has been financially struggling for years.  When a handsome stranger, Charlie, shows up at Emily�s family dairy farm at Christmastime, Emily has to hide her feelings for him when he turns out to be her sister�s partner and they are there to sell the farm. Can Emily get her Christmas miracle to save the family farm and win the handsome guy in the end?

Emily is faced with the daunting task of fulfilling her late mother Ruby’s last wish – a twelve-task Christmas Checklist. With local freelance writer Noah covering her compelling story, his article turns from inspiring to cherished just in time for Christmas Eve, as their journey together reveals that Ruby’s final wish has been in front of them the whole time.

Daisy, a determined real estate broker, inherits her grandfather’s ranch just before Christmas. Focused on selling, she returns home only to reconnect with Ben, her childhood crush who now works as a ranch hand. As holiday traditions stir memories and rekindle old feelings, Daisy begins to question the fast-paced career she’s built. With the season drawing to a close, she must decide between ambition and love.

A group of college students stay at school over Christmas to work at a special exhibit in the college's fine art gallery. When they decide to hold an unplanned Christmas Eve dinner in the gallery, they stumble into a trio of bumbling thugs planning a Holiday Heist of the exhibit. As the students are held hostage, they are forced to learn about themselves and each other.

Zeus, a Labrador Retriever and a former police dog (voiced by Mario Lopez), has lost his bark after his barking ended up blowing off a five-year investigation, ending him at the pound. He is adopted by a father as both an early Christmas present and as a hopeful guard dog for the house and his family.  When the family is away at Christmas, the less than dependable but crafty canine comes through and saves the home from two bumbling thieves.

It's a sun-soaked holiday season for the Bannister family as they travel to Southern California to stay with Aunt Barbara, who surprises them with a new puppy named Eve. Everyone is smitten with Eve - except for the Bannister's dog, Zeus, who sees what a mischievous animal she is. When Zeus sees Ted and Stewey, two thrifty thieves, trying to break into the family home while the Bannisters are at church, it's up to Zeus and Eve to join together to save the holidays for their family!

This Christmas, Riley Harper fights to save her small-town animal rescue from closing. Across the ocean, Prince Edward of Arendale travels to America to secure a land deal—unaware the property belongs to Riley. When fate (and a lost dog tag) brings them together, sparks fly. But when Riley learns Edward’s true identity, her trust shatters. On Christmas Eve, Edward risks it all to save her shelter—and her heart.

The tables have turned in this follow up to the popular 2021 romcom MY BOSS’ WEDDING. Recently engaged Nicole and Michael have plans for a small, intimate wedding surrounded by family and friends but Nicole’s boss thinks this is the perfect opportunity to return the favor by taking over the wedding planning.  Will Nicole’s boss’ plans for a rushed and over-the-top wedding bring the couple closer together... or will it drive them apart?

When Bella Fox’s dramatic exit from a hit dance competition goes viral, her best friend Hannah whisks her away to a quiet ballroom studio in upstate New York. Expecting peace, Bella instead meets Will, the studio’s kind property manager who hides a natural gift for dance. With a holiday showcase looming, they begin rehearsals, rediscovering passion, joy, and a spark that makes Bella question her future and what love truly looks like.

Prince Alexander of Fredonia, weary of his royal duties, escapes to America for Christmas, checking into a struggling inn under a false identity. Katie, the inn’s charming owner, welcomes Alex with open arms, unaware of his true status. As they share festive moments and grow closer, their bond deepens. But when Alex’s secret is revealed, Katie must decide if love is worth the risk of living in the royal spotlight.

At Christmastime in New York City, Julia Carter runs a nonprofit helping families in need. Still grieving her husband, she fights to keep hope alive—especially through her non-profit work and the annual tree lighting. Across the ocean, Prince Christopher escapes royal duties for a break in the U.S. When a chance meeting sparks connection, their bond deepens, and secrets and holiday pressures force them to face what truly matters.

Si-young has been chosen to play the lead role in an experimental art film centered around her dance major. Along with her college friend Chae-yoon, they perform geometric dance routines as part of a shamanic ceremony as directed by the film's director. However their world is turned upside down when a production team member suddenly falls from the roof but their seemingly lifeless body begins to move and come to life.

After finally realizing his dream of owning a house in Seoul, Dong-won held housewarming parties and invited some of his co-workers. But his happiness is short-lived as the entire building falls to the ground. Dongwon, his co-workers Kim and Eun-joo, and a nosy neighbor, Man-soo, must make it out of a 500-meter sinkhall.
Ja-yoon enters a TV contest to help her family, but mysterious figures disrupt her life, revealing secrets from her forgotten past.

Written and produced by Bong Joon-ho (PARASITE, SNOWPIERCER, THE HOST), SEA FOG is a maritime thriller that captures the essence of why he is considered on of the most talented filmmakers working today. Upon learning that his decaying fishing trawler, the Junjin, is about to be sold, Captain Kang looks to make one final score by smuggling illegal immigrants from China to South Korea.
